	/**
	 * Deletes every access and refresh token of a client, for all users.
	 * The client and its consents stay in place.
	 */
	async revokeAllTokensForClient(
		clientId: string,
	): Promise<{ accessTokens: number; refreshTokens: number }> {
		const [accessTokens, refreshTokens] = await Promise.all([
			this.accessTokenRepository.deleteAllForClient(clientId),
			this.refreshTokenRepository.deleteAllForClient(clientId),
		]);
		return { accessTokens, refreshTokens };
	}

	/**
	 * Counts the unexpired access tokens per grant, keyed by `${clientId}:${userId}`.
	 * Rows are not pruned on expiry, so the JWT `exp` claim decides. The unverified
	 * decode is safe here: the result only feeds a displayed count.
	 */
	async countActiveAccessTokensByGrant(clientIds: string[]): Promise<Map<string, number>> {
		const rows = await this.accessTokenRepository.findTokensByClientAndUsers(clientIds);
		const nowSeconds = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
		const counts = new Map<string, number>();

		for (const { token, clientId, userId } of rows) {
			const exp = this.getNumericClaim(this.jwtService.decodeUnverified(token), 'exp');
			if (exp === null || exp <= nowSeconds) continue;
			const key = `${clientId}:${userId}`;
			counts.set(key, (counts.get(key) ?? 0) + 1);
		}

		return counts;
	}

	private getNumericClaim(payload: unknown, claim: string): number | null {
		if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') return null;
		const value = (payload as Record<string, unknown>)[claim];
		return typeof value === 'number' ? value : null;
	}

    236   	private async verifyTokenWithAudiences(
    237   		token: string,
    238   		allowedAudiences: string[],
    239   	): Promise<AuthInfo> {
    240   		let decoded: unknown;
    241   
    242   		try {
    243   			decoded = await this.verifyJwt(token, allowedAudiences);
    244   		} catch (error) {
    245   			this.logger.debug('OAuth access token failed verification', {
    246   				error: ensureError(error).message,
    247   			});
    248   			throw new JWTVerificationError();
    249   		}
    250   
    251   		const clientId = this.getStringClaim(decoded, 'client_id');
    252   		const userId = this.getStringClaim(decoded, 'sub');
    253   		if (!clientId || !userId) {
    254   			throw new JWTVerificationError();
    255   		}
    256   
    257   		const accessTokenRecord = await this.accessTokenRepository.findOne({
    258   			where: { token },
    259   		});
    260   
    261   		if (!accessTokenRecord) {
    262   			throw new AccessTokenNotFoundError();
    263   		}
    264   
    265   		return {
    266   			token,
    267   			clientId,
    268   			scopes: this.parseScopeClaim(decoded),
    269   			extra: {
    270   				userId,
    271   			},
    272   		};
    273   	}

    275   	/**
    276   	 * Scopes carried by an access token. Tokens always carry a `scope` claim
    277   	 * (empty string for scope-less grants).
    278   	 */
    279   	private parseScopeClaim(decoded: unknown): string[] {
    280   		const scopeClaim = this.getStringClaim(decoded, 'scope');
    281   
    282   		// Migration 1784000000047 deleted every access token minted before
    283   		// scoping shipped, so a claim-less token cannot legitimately occur.
    284   		// Fail closed rather than granting anything.
    285   		if (scopeClaim === null) {
    286   			return [];
    287   		}
    288   
    289   		return scopeClaim === '' ? [] : scopeClaim.split(' ');
    290   	}

    292   	async verifyOAuthAccessToken(
    293   		token: string,
    294   		expectedAudience?: string,
    295   		grant?: OAuthResourceGrant,
    296   	): Promise<UserWithContext> {

    298   			const resource = await this.getResourceByAudience(expectedAudience);
    299   
    300   			// Fail closed: a token bearing a resource-scoped audience whose resource
    301   			// can't be resolved (deleted, or a transient resolver failure the registry
    302   			// swallows to `undefined`) must NOT bypass the authorize gate below.
    303   			//
    304   			// A sealed grant stands in for the resource rather than bypassing it — it is
    305   			// minted by this instance only once this gate has passed, and supplies the
    306   			// same audiences and execute check the resource would have.
    307   			if (expectedAudience && !resource && !grant) {
    308   				return { user: null, context: { reason: 'insufficient_scope', auth_type: 'oauth' } };
    309   			}
    310   
    311   			const authInfo = await this.verifyTokenWithAudiences(
    312   				token,
    313   				resource || !grant
    314   					? this.audiencesForResource(resource, expectedAudience)
    315   					: grant.audiences,
    316   			);
    317   
    318   			const userId =
    319   				authInfo.extra && typeof authInfo.extra === 'object'
    320   					? this.getStringClaim(authInfo.extra, 'userId')
    321   					: null;
    322   			if (!userId) {
    323   				return { user: null, context: { reason: 'user_id_not_in_auth_info', auth_type: 'oauth' } };
    324   			}
    325   
    326   			const user = await this.userRepository.findOne({
    327   				where: { id: userId },
    328   				relations: ['role'],
    329   			});
    330   
    331   			if (!user) {
    332   				return { user: null, context: { reason: 'user_not_found', auth_type: 'oauth' } };
    333   			}
    334   
    335   			if (user.disabled) {
    336   				return { user: null, context: { reason: 'user_disabled', auth_type: 'oauth' } };
    337   			}
    338   
    339   			if (!(await this.isAuthorized(user, resource, grant))) {
    340   				this.logger.warn('OAuth token denied: user lacks execute access', {
    341   					userId: user.id,
    342   					expectedAudience,
    343   				});
    344   				return { user: null, context: { reason: 'insufficient_scope', auth_type: 'oauth' } };
    345   			}
    346   
    347   			// Handed back so a caller whose work outlives this resource can seal the gate it
    348   			// was just admitted by.
    349   			return {
    350   				user,
    351   				caller: { authType: 'oauth', clientId: authInfo.clientId },
    352   				scopes: authInfo.scopes,
    353   				grant: resource?.getGrant?.(),
    354   			};
    355   		} catch (error) {
    356   			const errorForSure = ensureError(error);
    357   			const reason =
    358   				errorForSure instanceof JWTVerificationError
    359   					? 'invalid_token'
    360   					: errorForSure instanceof AccessTokenNotFoundError
    361   						? 'token_not_found_in_db'
    362   						: 'unknown_error';
    363   			return {
    364   				user: null,
    365   				context: {
    366   					reason,
    367   					auth_type: 'oauth',
    368   					error_details: errorForSure.message,
    369   				},
    370   			};
    371   		}
    372   	}

    452   	/**
    453   	 * Resolve the `aud` values a token may carry for the given resource.
    454   	 *
    455   	 * Audiences come from the matching registered resource ONLY — never union
    456   	 * audiences across resources, otherwise a token minted for one resource
    457   	 * would pass another resource's gate (cross-resource token replay).
    458   	 * Resource-specific legacy audiences (e.g. the instance MCP server's
    459   	 * pre-RFC-8707 `mcp-server-api`) stay scoped to their own resource this way.
    460   	 */
    461   	private async getAllowedAudiences(expectedAudience?: string): Promise<string[]> {
    462   		const resource = expectedAudience
    463   			? await this.resourceRegistry.getByResourceUrl(expectedAudience)
    464   			: undefined;
    465   		return this.audiencesForResource(resource, expectedAudience);
    466   	}

    468   	/**

    470   	 * Single source of the audience-derivation rule shared by `getAllowedAudiences`

    473   	private audiencesForResource(
    474   		resource: ProtectedResource | undefined,
    475   		expectedAudience?: string,
    476   	): string[] {
    477   		if (expectedAudience) {
    478   			return resource ? resource.getAudiences() : [expectedAudience];
    479   		}
    480   
    481   		// No expected audience: the caller cannot know which resource the token
    482   		// targets (MCP SDK generic verification), so accept any registered
    483   		// resource's audiences. Resource gates must pass `expectedAudience`.
    484   		return this.resourceRegistry.getAllAudiences();
    485   	}

    487   	/**

    492   		user: User,
    493   		resource: ProtectedResource | undefined,
    494   		grant: OAuthResourceGrant | undefined,
    495   	): Promise<boolean> {
    496   		if (resource) return await resource.authorize(user);
    497   
    498   		if (!grant) return true;
    499   
    500   		return await authorizeAgainstGrant(this.workflowFinderService, grant, user);
    501   	}

    518   		const decoded = this.jwtService.decodeUnverifiedWithHeader(token);
    519   		if (!decoded) {
    520   			throw new JsonWebTokenError('jwt malformed');
    521   		}
    522   
    523   		if (Object.hasOwn(decoded.header, 'kid')) {
    524   			return await this.signingKeyService.verifyAccessToken(token, {
    525   				kid: decoded.header.kid,
    526   				audiences,
    527   				issuer: this.urlService.getInstanceBaseUrl(),
    528   			});
    529   		}
    530   
    531   		return this.verifyLegacyHmacJwt(token, audiences);
    532   	}
    533   
    534   	// TODO: remove once every process mints ES256 and the last HS256 tokens
    535   	// have expired. Drops the legacy audiences and the per-audience fallback
    536   	// for tokens minted before n8n v2.19 at the same time.
    537   	private verifyLegacyHmacJwt(token: string, audiences: string[]): unknown {
    538   		try {
    539   			return this.jwtService.verifyLegacyHmacAccessToken(token, audiences as [string, ...string[]]);
    540   		} catch (error) {
    541   			// Some jsonwebtoken builds reject the array form for tokens signed with a single-string aud.
    542   			for (const audience of audiences) {
    543   				try {
    544   					return this.jwtService.verifyLegacyHmacAccessToken(token, audience);
    545   				} catch {
    546   					continue;
    547   				}
    548   			}
    549   
    550   			throw error;
    551   		}
    552   	}
    553   
    554   	private getStringClaim(payload: unknown, claim: string): string | null {
    555   		if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') return null;
    556   		const claimValue = (payload as Record<string, unknown>)[claim];
    557   		return typeof claimValue === 'string' ? claimValue : null;
    558   	}
    559   }

     77   	private pickCredentialId(
     78   		provider: ChatHubProvider,
     79   		credentials: INodeCredentials,
     80   	): string | null {
     81   		if (provider === 'n8n' || provider === 'custom-agent') {
     82   			return null;
     83   		}
     84   
     85   		return credentials[PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_TYPE_MAP[provider]]?.id ?? null;
     86   	}

     88   	private async ensurePreviousMessage(
     89   		previousMessageId: ChatMessageId | null,
     90   		sessionId: string,
     91   		trx?: EntityManager,
     92   	) {
     93   		if (!previousMessageId) {
     94   			return;
     95   		}
     96   
     97   		const previousMessage = await this.messageRepository.getOneById(
     98   			previousMessageId,
     99   			sessionId,
    100   			[],
    101   			trx,
    102   		);
    103   		if (!previousMessage) {
    104   			throw new BadRequestError('The previous message does not exist in the session');
    105   		}
    106   
    107   		return previousMessage;
    108   	}

    110   	/**
    111   	 * If the previous message is in 'waiting' state (e.g. Chat node waiting for user input),
    112   	 * resume the waiting execution instead of starting a new one. Returns true if resumed.
    113   	 */
    114   	private async tryResumeWaitingExecution(opts: {
    115   		workflow: PreparedChatWorkflow;
    116   		previousMessage: ChatHubMessage | undefined;
    117   		message: string;
    118   		sessionId: ChatSessionId;
    119   		user: User;
    120   		messageId: ChatMessageId;
    121   		model: ChatHubConversationModel;
    122   	}): Promise<boolean> {
    123   		const { workflow, previousMessage, message, sessionId, user, messageId, model } = opts;
    124   
    125   		if (
    126   			model.provider !== 'n8n' ||
    127   			workflow.responseMode !== 'responseNodes' ||
    128   			previousMessage?.status !== 'waiting' ||
    129   			!previousMessage?.executionId
    130   		) {
    131   			return false;
    132   		}
    133   
    134   		const execution = await this.executionPersistence.findSingleExecution(
    135   			previousMessage.executionId.toString(),
    136   			{
    137   				includeData: true,
    138   				unflattenData: true,
    139   			},
    140   		);
    141   		if (!execution) {
    142   			throw new OperationalError('Chat session has expired.');
    143   		}
    144   
    145   		// Only resume nodes a chat message is meant to drive (see
    146   		// ChatExecutionManager.canResumeOverChat) — the same allowlist the chat
    147   		// websocket uses. A workflow parked on, e.g., a Send-and-Wait approval gate
    148   		// must not be advanced by the next chat message; refuse before any state
    149   		// changes so the gate stays waiting for its real responder.
    150   		if (!this.executionManager.canResumeOverChat(execution)) {
    151   			this.logger.warn(
    152   				`Refused chat-hub resume for execution ${execution.id}: suspended node is not resumable over chat`,
    153   			);
    154   			throw new BadRequestError(
    155   				'This conversation is waiting for a response that cannot be provided from chat.',
    156   			);
    157   		}
    158   
    159   		this.logger.debug(
    160   			`Resuming execution ${execution.id} from waiting state for session ${sessionId}`,
    161   		);
    162   
    163   		await this.messageRepository.updateChatMessage(previousMessage.id, {
    164   			status: 'success',
    165   		});
    166   
    167   		void this.chatHubExecutionService.resumeChatExecution(
    168   			execution,
    169   			message,
    170   			sessionId,
    171   			user,
    172   			messageId,
    173   			model,
    174   			workflow.responseMode,
    175   		);
    176   		return true;
    177   	}
    178   
    179   	async stopGeneration(user: User, sessionId: ChatSessionId, messageId: ChatMessageId) {
    180   		await this.ensureConversation(user.id, sessionId);
    181   
    182   		const message = await this.getChatMessage(sessionId, messageId, [
    183   			'execution',
    184   			'execution.workflow',
    185   		]);
    186   
    187   		if (message.type !== 'ai') {
    188   			throw new BadRequestError('Can only stop AI messages');
    189   		}
    190   
    191   		if (!message.executionId || !message.execution) {
    192   			throw new BadRequestError('Message is not associated with a workflow execution');
    193   		}
    194   
    195   		if (message.status !== 'running') {
    196   			throw new BadRequestError('Can only stop messages that are currently running');
    197   		}
    198   
    199   		await this.chatHubExecutionService.stop(message.execution.id, message.execution.workflowId);
    200   		await this.messageRepository.updateChatMessage(messageId, { status: 'cancelled' });
    201   	}

    203   	private getModelCredential(model: ChatHubConversationModel, credentials: INodeCredentials) {

    206   
    207   		return credentialId;
    208   	}

    214   	private async createChatSession(
    215   		user: User,
    216   		sessionId: ChatSessionId,
    217   		model: ChatHubConversationModel,
    218   		credentialId: string | null,
    219   		manual: boolean,
    220   		agentName?: string,
    221   		trx?: EntityManager,
    222   	) {
    223   		await this.ensureValidModel(user, model, manual, trx);
    224   
    225   		const session = await this.sessionRepository.createChatSession(
    226   			{
    227   				id: sessionId,
    228   				ownerId: user.id,
    229   				title: 'New Chat',
    230   				lastMessageAt: new Date(),
    231   				agentName,
    232   				credentialId,
    233   				type: manual ? 'manual' : 'production',
    234   				...model,
    235   			},
    236   			trx,
    237   		);
    238   
    239   		// Populate session tools from enabled configured tools
    240   		const enabledTools = await this.chatHubToolService.getEnabledTools(user.id, trx);
    241   		const toolIds = enabledTools.map((t) => t.id);
    242   		if (toolIds.length > 0) {
    243   			await this.chatHubToolService.setSessionTools(sessionId, user.id, toolIds, trx);
    244   		}
    245   
    246   		return session;
    247   	}

    249   	private async getChatMessage(
    250   		sessionId: ChatSessionId,
    251   		messageId: ChatMessageId,
    252   		relations: string[] = [],
    253   		trx?: EntityManager,
    254   	) {
    255   		const message = await this.messageRepository.getOneById(messageId, sessionId, relations, trx);
    256   		if (!message) {
    257   			throw new NotFoundError('Chat message not found');
    258   		}
    259   		return message;

    262   	/**
    263   	 * Get all conversations for a user
    264   	 */
    265   	async getConversations(
    266   		userId: string,
    267   		limit: number,
    268   		cursor?: string,
    269   		type?: string,
    270   	): Promise<ChatHubConversationsResponse> {
    271   		const sessions = await this.sessionRepository.getManyByUserId(userId, limit + 1, cursor, type);
    272   
    273   		const hasMore = sessions.length > limit;
    274   		const data = hasMore ? sessions.slice(0, limit) : sessions;
    275   		const nextCursor = hasMore ? data[data.length - 1].id : null;
    276   
    277   		return {
    278   			data: data.map((session) => this.convertSessionEntityToDto(session)),
    279   			nextCursor,
    280   			hasMore,
    281   		};
    282   	}

    284   	/**
    285   	 * Ensures conversation exists and belongs to the user, throws otherwise
    286   	 * */
    287   	async ensureConversation(userId: string, sessionId: string, trx?: EntityManager): Promise<void> {
    288   		const sessionExists = await this.sessionRepository.existsById(sessionId, userId, trx);
    289   		if (!sessionExists) {
    290   			throw new NotFoundError('Chat session not found');
    291   		}
    292   	}

    294   	/**
    295   	 * Get a single conversation with messages and ready to render timeline of latest messages
    296   	 * */
    297   	async getConversation(userId: string, sessionId: string): Promise<ChatHubConversationResponse> {
    298   		const session = await this.sessionRepository.getOneById(sessionId, userId);
    299   		if (!session) {
    300   			throw new NotFoundError('Chat session not found');
    301   		}
    302   
    303   		const messages = session.messages ?? [];
    304   		const toolIds = await this.chatHubToolService.getToolIdsForSession(sessionId);
    305   
    306   		return {
    307   			session: this.convertSessionEntityToDto(session, toolIds),
    308   			conversation: {
    309   				messages: Object.fromEntries(messages.map((m) => [m.id, this.convertMessageToDto(m)])),
    310   			},
    311   		};
    312   	}

    314   	/**
    315   	 * Build the message history chain ending to the message with ID `lastMessageId`
    316   	 */
    317   	private buildMessageHistory(
    318   		messages: Record<ChatMessageId, ChatHubMessage>,
    319   		lastMessageId: ChatMessageId | null,
    320   	) {
    321   		if (!lastMessageId) return [];
    322   
    323   		const visited = new Set<string>();
    324   		const historyIds = [];
    325   
    326   		let current: ChatMessageId | null = lastMessageId;
    327   
    328   		while (current && !visited.has(current)) {
    329   			historyIds.unshift(current);
    330   			visited.add(current);
    331   			current = messages[current]?.previousMessageId ?? null;
    332   		}
    333   
    334   		const history = historyIds.flatMap((id) => messages[id] ?? []);
    335   		return history;
    336   	}

    344   	/**
    345   	 * Updates a session with the provided fields
    346   	 */
    347   	async updateSession(
    348   		user: User,
    349   		sessionId: ChatSessionId,
    350   		updates: ChatHubUpdateConversationRequest,
    351   	) {
    352   		await this.ensureConversation(user.id, sessionId);
    353   
    354   		// Prepare the actual updates to be sent to the repository
    355   		const sessionUpdates: Partial<IChatHubSession> = {};
    356   
    357   		if (updates.agent) {
    358   			const model = updates.agent.model;
    359   
    360   			await this.ensureValidModel(user, model, false);
    361   
    362   			sessionUpdates.agentName = updates.agent.name;
    363   			sessionUpdates.provider = model.provider;
    364   			sessionUpdates.model = null;
    365   			sessionUpdates.credentialId = null;
    366   			sessionUpdates.agentId = null;
    367   			sessionUpdates.workflowId = null;
    368   
    369   			if (updates.agent.model.provider === 'n8n') {
    370   				sessionUpdates.workflowId = updates.agent.model.workflowId;
    371   			} else if (updates.agent.model.provider === 'custom-agent') {
    372   				sessionUpdates.agentId = updates.agent.model.agentId;
    373   			} else {
    374   				sessionUpdates.model = updates.agent.model.model;
    375   			}
    376   		}
    377   
    378   		if (updates.title !== undefined) sessionUpdates.title = updates.title;
    379   		if (updates.credentialId !== undefined) sessionUpdates.credentialId = updates.credentialId;
    380   
    381   		// One transaction: a rejected tool or a failed field update leaves the session unchanged
    382   		const { toolIds } = updates;
    383   		await this.sessionRepository.runInTransaction({}, async (trx) => {
    384   			if (toolIds !== undefined) {
    385   				await this.chatHubToolService.setSessionTools(sessionId, user.id, toolIds, trx);
    386   			}
    387   			await this.sessionRepository.updateChatSession(sessionId, sessionUpdates, trx);
    388   		});
    389   	}

    391   	/**
    392   	 * Deletes a session
    393   	 */
    394   	async deleteSession(userId: string, sessionId: ChatSessionId) {
    395   		await this.messageRepository.manager.transaction(async (trx) => {
    396   			await this.ensureConversation(userId, sessionId, trx);
    397   			await this.chatHubAttachmentService.deleteAllBySessionId(sessionId, trx);
    398   			await this.sessionRepository.deleteChatHubSession(sessionId, trx);
    399   		});
    400   	}

    424   	private async ensureValidModel(
    425   		user: User,
    426   		model: ChatHubConversationModel,
    427   		manual: boolean,
    428   		trx?: EntityManager,
    429   	) {
    430   		if (model.provider === 'custom-agent') {
    431   			// Find the agent to get its name
    432   			const agent = await this.chatHubAgentService.getAgentById(model.agentId, user.id, trx);
    433   			if (!agent) {
    434   				throw new BadRequestError('Agent not found for chat session initialization');
    435   			}
    436   		}
    437   
    438   		if (model.provider === 'n8n') {
    439   			// Find the workflow to get its name
    440   			const workflowEntity = await this.workflowFinderService.findWorkflowForUser(
    441   				model.workflowId,
    442   				user,
    443   				['workflow:execute-chat'],
    444   				{
    445   					includeTags: false,
    446   					includeParentFolder: false,
    447   					includeActiveVersion: manual ? false : true,
    448   					em: trx,
    449   				},
    450   			);
    451   
    452   			if (!workflowEntity) {
    453   				throw new BadRequestError('Workflow not found for chat session initialization');
    454   			}
    455   
    456   			// In manual mode, validate against draft nodes; otherwise use activeVersion
    457   			const nodes = manual ? workflowEntity.nodes : workflowEntity.activeVersion?.nodes;
    458   
    459   			if (!nodes) {
    460   				throw new BadRequestError('Workflow not found for chat session initialization');
    461   			}
    462   
    463   			const chatTrigger = nodes.find((node) => node.type === CHAT_TRIGGER_NODE_TYPE);
    464   
    465   			if (!chatTrigger) {
    466   				throw new BadRequestError(
    467   					'Chat trigger not found in workflow for chat session initialization',
    468   				);
    469   			}
    470   		}
    471   	}

    473   	/**
    474   	 * Send a human message and stream the AI response via Push events.
    475   	 * Returns immediately, streaming happens in background after.
    476   	 */
    477   	async sendHumanMessage(
    478   		user: User,
    479   		payload: HumanMessagePayload,
    480   		executionMetadata: ChatHubAuthenticationMetadata,
    481   	): Promise<void> {
    482   		const {
    483   			sessionId,
    484   			messageId,
    485   			message,
    486   			model,
    487   			credentials,
    488   			previousMessageId,
    489   			attachments,
    490   			timeZone,
    491   		} = payload;
    492   		const tz = timeZone ?? this.globalConfig.generic.timezone;
    493   
    494   		const credentialId = this.getModelCredential(model, credentials);
    495   
    496   		let processedAttachments: IBinaryData[] = [];
    497   		let workflow: PreparedChatWorkflow;
    498   		let previousMessage: ChatHubMessage | undefined;
    499   
    500   		try {
    501   			const result = await this.messageRepository.runInTransaction({}, async (trx, ctx) => {
    502   				let session = await this.getChatSession(user, sessionId, trx);
    503   				const isNewSession = !session;
    504   				session ??= await this.createChatSession(
    505   					user,
    506   					sessionId,
    507   					model,
    508   					credentialId,
    509   					false,
    510   					payload.agentName,
    511   					trx,
    512   				);
    513   
    514   				const previousMessage = await this.ensurePreviousMessage(previousMessageId, sessionId, trx);
    515   				const messages = Object.fromEntries((session.messages ?? []).map((m) => [m.id, m]));
    516   				const history = this.buildMessageHistory(messages, previousMessageId);
    517   
    518   				// Validate attachments against the model's upload policy before storing
    519   				if (attachments.length > 0) {
    520   					const policy = await this.chatHubWorkflowService.getAttachmentPolicy(model, user, trx);
    521   					this.chatHubAttachmentService.validateAttachments(
    522   						attachments,
    523   						policy.allowFileUploads,
    524   						policy.allowedFilesMimeTypes,
    525   					);
    526   				}
    527   
    528   				// Store attachments to populate 'id' field via BinaryDataService
    529   				processedAttachments = await this.chatHubAttachmentService.store(
    530   					sessionId,
    531   					messageId,
    532   					attachments,
    533   				);
    534   
    535   				await this.messageRepository.createHumanMessage(
    536   					payload,
    537   					processedAttachments,
    538   					user,
    539   					previousMessageId,
    540   					model,
    541   					undefined,
    542   					trx,
    543   				);
    544   
    545   				// Resolve tool definitions from the session's join table
    546   				const tools = isNewSession
    547   					? (await this.chatHubToolService.getEnabledTools(user.id, trx)).map((t) => t.definition)
    548   					: await this.chatHubToolService.getToolDefinitionsForSession(sessionId, trx);
    549   
    550   				const replyWorkflow = await this.chatHubWorkflowService.prepareReplyWorkflow(
    551   					user,
    552   					sessionId,
    553   					credentials,
    554   					model,
    555   					history,
    556   					message,
    557   					tools,
    558   					processedAttachments,
    559   					tz,
    560   					ctx,
    561   					executionMetadata,
    562   				);
    563   
    564   				return { workflow: replyWorkflow, previousMessage };
    565   			});
    566   			workflow = result.workflow;
    567   			previousMessage = result.previousMessage;
    568   		} catch (error) {
    569   			if (processedAttachments.length > 0) {
    570   				try {
    571   					await this.chatHubAttachmentService.deleteAttachments(processedAttachments);
    572   				} catch {
    573   					this.errorReporter.warn(`Could not clean up ${processedAttachments.length} files`);
    574   				}
    575   			}
    576   
    577   			throw error;
    578   		}
    579   
    580   		if (!workflow) {
    581   			throw new UnexpectedError('Failed to prepare chat workflow.');
    582   		}
    583   
    584   		// Broadcast human message to all user connections for cross-client sync
    585   		await this.chatStreamService.sendHumanMessage({
    586   			userId: user.id,
    587   			sessionId,
    588   			messageId,
    589   			previousMessageId,
    590   			content: message,
    591   			attachments: processedAttachments.map((a) => ({
    592   				id: a.id!,
    593   				fileName: a.fileName ?? 'file',
    594   				mimeType: a.mimeType,
    595   			})),
    596   		});
    597   
    598   		const resumed = await this.tryResumeWaitingExecution({
    599   			workflow,
    600   			previousMessage,
    601   			message,
    602   			sessionId,
    603   			user,
    604   			messageId,
    605   			model,
    606   		});
    607   		if (resumed) return;
    608   
    609   		// Start the workflow execution with streaming
    610   		void this.executeChatWorkflowWithCleanup(
    611   			user,
    612   			model,
    613   			workflow,
    614   			sessionId,
    615   			messageId,
    616   			null,
    617   			previousMessageId,
    618   			credentials,

    277   		return {
    278   			data: data.map((session) => this.convertSessionEntityToDto(session)),
    279   			nextCursor,
    280   			hasMore,
    281   		};
    282   	}

    297   	async getConversation(userId: string, sessionId: string): Promise<ChatHubConversationResponse> {
    298   		const session = await this.sessionRepository.getOneById(sessionId, userId);
    299   		if (!session) {

    301   		}

    305   
    306   		return {

    308   			conversation: {

    310   			},
    311   		};

    314   	/**
    315   	 * Build the message history chain ending to the message with ID `lastMessageId`
    316   	 */
    317   	private buildMessageHistory(
    318   		messages: Record<ChatMessageId, ChatHubMessage>,
    319   		lastMessageId: ChatMessageId | null,
    320   	) {
    321   		if (!lastMessageId) return [];
    322   
    323   		const visited = new Set<string>();
    324   		const historyIds = [];
    325   
    326   		let current: ChatMessageId | null = lastMessageId;
    327   
    328   		while (current && !visited.has(current)) {
    329   			historyIds.unshift(current);
    330   			visited.add(current);
    331   			current = messages[current]?.previousMessageId ?? null;
    332   		}
    333   
    334   		const history = historyIds.flatMap((id) => messages[id] ?? []);
    335   		return history;
    336   	}

    344   	/**
    345   	 * Updates a session with the provided fields
    346   	 */
    347   	async updateSession(
    348   		user: User,
    349   		sessionId: ChatSessionId,
    350   		updates: ChatHubUpdateConversationRequest,
    351   	) {
    352   		await this.ensureConversation(user.id, sessionId);
    353   
    354   		// Prepare the actual updates to be sent to the repository
    355   		const sessionUpdates: Partial<IChatHubSession> = {};
    356   
    357   		if (updates.agent) {
    358   			const model = updates.agent.model;
    359   
    360   			await this.ensureValidModel(user, model, false);
    361   
    362   			sessionUpdates.agentName = updates.agent.name;
    363   			sessionUpdates.provider = model.provider;
    364   			sessionUpdates.model = null;
    365   			sessionUpdates.credentialId = null;
    366   			sessionUpdates.agentId = null;
    367   			sessionUpdates.workflowId = null;
    368   
    369   			if (updates.agent.model.provider === 'n8n') {
    370   				sessionUpdates.workflowId = updates.agent.model.workflowId;
    371   			} else if (updates.agent.model.provider === 'custom-agent') {
    372   				sessionUpdates.agentId = updates.agent.model.agentId;
    373   			} else {
    374   				sessionUpdates.model = updates.agent.model.model;
    375   			}
    376   		}
    377   
    378   		if (updates.title !== undefined) sessionUpdates.title = updates.title;
    379   		if (updates.credentialId !== undefined) sessionUpdates.credentialId = updates.credentialId;
    380   
    381   		// One transaction: a rejected tool or a failed field update leaves the session unchanged
    382   		const { toolIds } = updates;
    383   		await this.sessionRepository.runInTransaction({}, async (trx) => {
    384   			if (toolIds !== undefined) {
    385   				await this.chatHubToolService.setSessionTools(sessionId, user.id, toolIds, trx);
    386   			}
    387   			await this.sessionRepository.updateChatSession(sessionId, sessionUpdates, trx);
    388   		});
    389   	}

    397   			await this.chatHubAttachmentService.deleteAllBySessionId(sessionId, trx);
    398   			await this.sessionRepository.deleteChatHubSession(sessionId, trx);
    399   		});

    420   	private async ensureValidModel(
    421   		user: User,
    422   		model: ChatHubConversationModel,
    423   		manual: boolean,
    424   		trx?: EntityManager,
    425   	) {
    426   		if (model.provider === 'custom-agent') {
    427   			// Find the agent to get its name
    428   			const agent = await this.chatHubAgentService.getAgentById(model.agentId, user.id, trx);
    429   			if (!agent) {
    430   				throw new BadRequestError('Agent not found for chat session initialization');
    431   			}
    432   		}
    433   
    434   		if (model.provider === 'n8n') {
    435   			// Find the workflow to get its name
    436   			const workflowEntity = await this.workflowFinderService.findWorkflowForUser(
    437   				model.workflowId,
    438   				user,
    439   				['workflow:execute-chat'],
    440   				{
    441   					includeTags: false,
    442   					includeParentFolder: false,
    443   					includeActiveVersion: manual ? false : true,
    444   					em: trx,
    445   				},
    446   			);
    447   
    448   			if (!workflowEntity) {
    449   				throw new BadRequestError('Workflow not found for chat session initialization');
    450   			}
    451   
    452   			// In manual mode, validate against draft nodes; otherwise use activeVersion
    453   			const nodes = manual ? workflowEntity.nodes : workflowEntity.activeVersion?.nodes;
    454   
    455   			if (!nodes) {
    456   				throw new BadRequestError('Workflow not found for chat session initialization');
    457   			}
    458   
    459   			const chatTrigger = nodes.find((node) => node.type === CHAT_TRIGGER_NODE_TYPE);
    460   
    461   			if (!chatTrigger) {
    462   				throw new BadRequestError(
    463   					'Chat trigger not found in workflow for chat session initialization',
    464   				);
    465   			}
    466   		}
    467   	}

    469   	/**
    470   	 * Send a human message and stream the AI response via Push events.
    471   	 * Returns immediately, streaming happens in background after.
    472   	 */
    473   	async sendHumanMessage(
    474   		user: User,
    475   		payload: HumanMessagePayload,
    476   		executionMetadata: ChatHubAuthenticationMetadata,
    477   	): Promise<void> {
    478   		const {
    479   			sessionId,
    480   			messageId,
    481   			message,
    482   			model,
    483   			credentials,
    484   			previousMessageId,
    485   			attachments,
    486   			timeZone,
    487   		} = payload;
    488   		const tz = timeZone ?? this.globalConfig.generic.timezone;
    489   
    490   		const credentialId = this.getModelCredential(model, credentials);
    491   
    492   		let processedAttachments: IBinaryData[] = [];
    493   		let workflow: PreparedChatWorkflow;
    494   		let previousMessage: ChatHubMessage | undefined;
    495   
    496   		try {
    497   			const result = await this.messageRepository.runInTransaction({}, async (trx, ctx) => {
    498   				let session = await this.getChatSession(user, sessionId, trx);
    499   				const isNewSession = !session;
    500   				session ??= await this.createChatSession(
    501   					user,
    502   					sessionId,
    503   					model,
    504   					credentialId,
    505   					false,
    506   					payload.agentName,
    507   					trx,
    508   				);
    509   
    510   				const previousMessage = await this.ensurePreviousMessage(previousMessageId, sessionId, trx);
    511   				const messages = Object.fromEntries((session.messages ?? []).map((m) => [m.id, m]));
    512   				const history = this.buildMessageHistory(messages, previousMessageId);
    513   
    514   				// Validate attachments against the model's upload policy before storing
    515   				if (attachments.length > 0) {
    516   					const policy = await this.chatHubWorkflowService.getAttachmentPolicy(model, user, trx);
    517   					this.chatHubAttachmentService.validateAttachments(
    518   						attachments,
    519   						policy.allowFileUploads,
    520   						policy.allowedFilesMimeTypes,
    521   					);
    522   				}
    523   
    524   				// Store attachments to populate 'id' field via BinaryDataService
    525   				processedAttachments = await this.chatHubAttachmentService.store(
    526   					sessionId,
    527   					messageId,
    528   					attachments,
    529   				);
    530   
    531   				await this.messageRepository.createHumanMessage(
    532   					payload,
    533   					processedAttachments,
    534   					user,
    535   					previousMessageId,
    536   					model,
    537   					undefined,
    538   					trx,
    539   				);
    540   
    541   				// Resolve tool definitions from the session's join table
    542   				const tools = isNewSession
    543   					? (await this.chatHubToolService.getEnabledTools(user.id, trx)).map((t) => t.definition)
    544   					: await this.chatHubToolService.getToolDefinitionsForSession(sessionId, trx);
    545   
    546   				const replyWorkflow = await this.chatHubWorkflowService.prepareReplyWorkflow(
    547   					user,
    548   					sessionId,
    549   					credentials,
    550   					model,
    551   					history,
    552   					message,
    553   					tools,
    554   					processedAttachments,
    555   					tz,
    556   					ctx,
    557   					executionMetadata,
    558   				);
    559   
    560   				return { workflow: replyWorkflow, previousMessage };
    561   			});
    562   			workflow = result.workflow;
    563   			previousMessage = result.previousMessage;
    564   		} catch (error) {
    565   			if (processedAttachments.length > 0) {
    566   				try {
    567   					await this.chatHubAttachmentService.deleteAttachments(processedAttachments);
    568   				} catch {
    569   					this.errorReporter.warn(`Could not clean up ${processedAttachments.length} files`);
    570   				}
    571   			}
    572   
    573   			throw error;
    574   		}
    575   
    576   		if (!workflow) {
    577   			throw new UnexpectedError('Failed to prepare chat workflow.');
    578   		}
    579   
    580   		// Broadcast human message to all user connections for cross-client sync
    581   		await this.chatStreamService.sendHumanMessage({
    582   			userId: user.id,
    583   			sessionId,
    584   			messageId,
    585   			previousMessageId,
    586   			content: message,
    587   			attachments: processedAttachments.map((a) => ({
    588   				id: a.id!,
    589   				fileName: a.fileName ?? 'file',
    590   				mimeType: a.mimeType,
    591   			})),
    592   		});
    593   
    594   		const resumed = await this.tryResumeWaitingExecution({
    595   			workflow,
    596   			previousMessage,
    597   			message,
    598   			sessionId,
    599   			user,
    600   			messageId,
    601   			model,
    602   		});
    603   		if (resumed) return;
    604   
    605   		// Start the workflow execution with streaming
    606   		void this.executeChatWorkflowWithCleanup(
    607   			user,
    608   			model,
    609   			workflow,
    610   			sessionId,
    611   			messageId,
    612   			null,
    613   			previousMessageId,
    614   			credentials,
    615   			message,
    616   			processedAttachments,
    617   		);
    618   	}

    778   	/**
    779   	 * Edit a message and stream the AI response via Push events.
    780   	 * Returns immediately, streaming happens in background after.
    781   	 */
    782   	async editMessage(
    783   		user: User,
    784   		payload: EditMessagePayload,
    785   		executionMetadata: ChatHubAuthenticationMetadata,
    786   	): Promise<void> {
    787   		const { sessionId, editId, messageId, message, model, credentials, timeZone } = payload;
    788   		const tz = timeZone ?? this.globalConfig.generic.timezone;
    789   
    790   		let result: {
    791   			workflow: PreparedChatWorkflow | null;
    792   			combinedAttachments: IBinaryData[];
    793   		} | null = null;
    794   		let newStoredAttachments: IBinaryData[] = [];
    795   
    796   		try {
    797   			result = await this.messageRepository.runInTransaction({}, async (trx, ctx) => {
    798   				const session = await this.getChatSession(user, sessionId, trx);
    799   				if (!session) {
    800   					throw new NotFoundError('Chat session not found');
    801   				}
    802   
    803   				const messageToEdit = await this.getChatMessage(session.id, editId, [], trx);
    804   
    805   				if (messageToEdit.type === 'ai') {
    806   					throw new BadRequestError('Editing AI messages is not supported');
    807   				}
    808   
    809   				if (messageToEdit.type === 'human') {
    810   					const messages = Object.fromEntries((session.messages ?? []).map((m) => [m.id, m]));
    811   					const history = this.buildMessageHistory(messages, messageToEdit.previousMessageId);
    812   
    813   					const revisionOfMessageId = messageToEdit.revisionOfMessageId ?? messageToEdit.id;
    814   					const originalAttachments = messageToEdit.attachments ?? [];
    815   
    816   					const keptAttachments = payload.keepAttachmentIndices.flatMap((index) => {
    817   						const attachment = originalAttachments[index];
    818   						return attachment ? [attachment] : [];
    819   					});
    820   
    821   					newStoredAttachments =
    822   						payload.newAttachments.length > 0
    823   							? await this.chatHubAttachmentService.store(
    824   									sessionId,
    825   									messageId,
    826   									payload.newAttachments,
    827   								)
    828   							: [];
    829   
    830   					const attachments = [...keptAttachments, ...newStoredAttachments];
    831   
    832   					await this.messageRepository.createHumanMessage(
    833   						payload,
    834   						attachments,
    835   						user,
    836   						messageToEdit.previousMessageId,
    837   						model,
    838   						revisionOfMessageId,
    839   						trx,
    840   					);
    841   
    842   					const tools = await this.chatHubToolService.getToolDefinitionsForSession(sessionId, trx);
    843   
    844   					const workflow = await this.chatHubWorkflowService.prepareReplyWorkflow(
    845   						user,
    846   						sessionId,
    847   						credentials,
    848   						model,
    849   						history,
    850   						message,
    851   						tools,
    852   						attachments,
    853   						tz,
    854   						ctx,
    855   						executionMetadata,
    856   					);
    857   
    858   					return { workflow, combinedAttachments: attachments };
    859   				}
    860   
    861   				throw new BadRequestError('Only human and AI messages can be edited');
    862   			});
    863   		} catch (error) {
    864   			if (newStoredAttachments.length > 0) {
    865   				try {
    866   					await this.chatHubAttachmentService.deleteAttachments(newStoredAttachments);
    867   				} catch {
    868   					this.errorReporter.warn(`Could not clean up ${newStoredAttachments.length} files`);
    869   				}
    870   			}
    871   
    872   			throw error;
    873   		}
    874   
    875   		if (!result?.workflow) {
    876   			// AI message edit - no streaming needed
    877   			return;
    878   		}
    879   
    880   		const { workflow } = result;
    881   
    882   		// Broadcast message edit to all user connections for cross-client sync
    883   		await this.chatStreamService.sendMessageEdit({
    884   			userId: user.id,
    885   			sessionId,
    886   			revisionOfMessageId: editId,
    887   			messageId,
    888   			content: message,
    889   			attachments: result.combinedAttachments.map((a) => ({
    890   				id: a.id!,
    891   				fileName: a.fileName ?? 'file',
    892   				mimeType: a.mimeType,
    893   			})),
    894   		});
    895

	/**
	 * Deletes the user's sessions whose last message is older than the given number of days.
	 * Returns the number of deleted sessions.
	 */
	async deleteStaleSessions(userId: string, olderThanDays: number): Promise<number> {
		const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - olderThanDays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);

		return await this.messageRepository.manager.transaction(async (trx) => {
			const ids = await this.sessionRepository.getIdsByUserIdLastMessageBefore(userId, cutoff, trx);

			for (const id of ids) {
				await this.chatHubAttachmentService.deleteAllBySessionId(id, trx);
			}

			return await this.sessionRepository.deleteManyByIdsAndUserId(ids, userId, trx);
		});
	}

    324   		const historyIds = [];
    325   
    326   		let current: ChatMessageId | null = lastMessageId;
    327   
    328   		while (current && !visited.has(current)) {
    329   			historyIds.unshift(current);
    330   			visited.add(current);
    331   			current = messages[current]?.previousMessageId ?? null;
    332   		}
    333   
    334   		const history = historyIds.flatMap((id) => messages[id] ?? []);
    335   		return history;
    336   	}

    344   	/**
    345   	 * Updates a session with the provided fields
    346   	 */
    347   	async updateSession(
    348   		user: User,
    349   		sessionId: ChatSessionId,
    350   		updates: ChatHubUpdateConversationRequest,
    351   	) {
    352   		await this.ensureConversation(user.id, sessionId);
    353   
    354   		// Prepare the actual updates to be sent to the repository
    355   		const sessionUpdates: Partial<IChatHubSession> = {};
    356   
    357   		if (updates.agent) {
    358   			const model = updates.agent.model;
    359   
    360   			await this.ensureValidModel(user, model, false);
    361   
    362   			sessionUpdates.agentName = updates.agent.name;
    363   			sessionUpdates.provider = model.provider;
    364   			sessionUpdates.model = null;
    365   			sessionUpdates.credentialId = null;
    366   			sessionUpdates.agentId = null;
    367   			sessionUpdates.workflowId = null;
    368   
    369   			if (updates.agent.model.provider === 'n8n') {
    370   				sessionUpdates.workflowId = updates.agent.model.workflowId;
    371   			} else if (updates.agent.model.provider === 'custom-agent') {
    372   				sessionUpdates.agentId = updates.agent.model.agentId;
    373   			} else {
    374   				sessionUpdates.model = updates.agent.model.model;
    375   			}
    376   		}
    377   
    378   		if (updates.title !== undefined) sessionUpdates.title = updates.title;
    379   		if (updates.credentialId !== undefined) sessionUpdates.credentialId = updates.credentialId;
    380   
    381   		// One transaction: a rejected tool or a failed field update leaves the session unchanged
    382   		const { toolIds } = updates;
    383   		await this.sessionRepository.runInTransaction({}, async (trx) => {
    384   			if (toolIds !== undefined) {
    385   				await this.chatHubToolService.setSessionTools(sessionId, user.id, toolIds, trx);
    386   			}
    387   			await this.sessionRepository.updateChatSession(sessionId, sessionUpdates, trx);
    388   		});
    389   	}

    398   			await this.sessionRepository.deleteChatHubSession(sessionId, trx);

    420   	private async ensureValidModel(
    421   		user: User,
    422   		model: ChatHubConversationModel,
    423   		manual: boolean,
    424   		trx?: EntityManager,
    425   	) {
    426   		if (model.provider === 'custom-agent') {
    427   			// Find the agent to get its name
    428   			const agent = await this.chatHubAgentService.getAgentById(model.agentId, user.id, trx);
    429   			if (!agent) {
    430   				throw new BadRequestError('Agent not found for chat session initialization');
    431   			}
    432   		}
    433   
    434   		if (model.provider === 'n8n') {
    435   			// Find the workflow to get its name
    436   			const workflowEntity = await this.workflowFinderService.findWorkflowForUser(
    437   				model.workflowId,
    438   				user,
    439   				['workflow:execute-chat'],
    440   				{
    441   					includeTags: false,
    442   					includeParentFolder: false,
    443   					includeActiveVersion: manual ? false : true,
    444   					em: trx,
    445   				},
    446   			);
    447   
    448   			if (!workflowEntity) {
    449   				throw new BadRequestError('Workflow not found for chat session initialization');
    450   			}
    451   
    452   			// In manual mode, validate against draft nodes; otherwise use activeVersion
    453   			const nodes = manual ? workflowEntity.nodes : workflowEntity.activeVersion?.nodes;
    454   
    455   			if (!nodes) {
    456   				throw new BadRequestError('Workflow not found for chat session initialization');
    457   			}
    458   
    459   			const chatTrigger = nodes.find((node) => node.type === CHAT_TRIGGER_NODE_TYPE);
    460   
    461   			if (!chatTrigger) {
    462   				throw new BadRequestError(
    463   					'Chat trigger not found in workflow for chat session initialization',
    464   				);
    465   			}
    466   		}
    467   	}

    469   	/**
    470   	 * Send a human message and stream the AI response via Push events.
    471   	 * Returns immediately, streaming happens in background after.
    472   	 */
    473   	async sendHumanMessage(
    474   		user: User,
    475   		payload: HumanMessagePayload,
    476   		executionMetadata: ChatHubAuthenticationMetadata,
    477   	): Promise<void> {
    478   		const {
    479   			sessionId,
    480   			messageId,
    481   			message,
    482   			model,
    483   			credentials,
    484   			previousMessageId,
    485   			attachments,
    486   			timeZone,
    487   		} = payload;
    488   		const tz = timeZone ?? this.globalConfig.generic.timezone;
    489   
    490   		const credentialId = this.getModelCredential(model, credentials);
    491   
    492   		let processedAttachments: IBinaryData[] = [];
    493   		let workflow: PreparedChatWorkflow;
    494   		let previousMessage: ChatHubMessage | undefined;
    495   
    496   		try {
    497   			const result = await this.messageRepository.runInTransaction({}, async (trx, ctx) => {
    498   				let session = await this.getChatSession(user, sessionId, trx);
    499   				const isNewSession = !session;
    500   				session ??= await this.createChatSession(
    501   					user,
    502   					sessionId,
    503   					model,
    504   					credentialId,
    505   					false,
    506   					payload.agentName,
    507   					trx,
    508   				);
    509   
    510   				const previousMessage = await this.ensurePreviousMessage(previousMessageId, sessionId, trx);
    511   				const messages = Object.fromEntries((session.messages ?? []).map((m) => [m.id, m]));
    512   				const history = this.buildMessageHistory(messages, previousMessageId);
    513   
    514   				// Validate attachments against the model's upload policy before storing
    515   				if (attachments.length > 0) {
    516   					const policy = await this.chatHubWorkflowService.getAttachmentPolicy(model, user, trx);
    517   					this.chatHubAttachmentService.validateAttachments(
    518   						attachments,
    519   						policy.allowFileUploads,
    520   						policy.allowedFilesMimeTypes,
    521   					);
    522   				}
    523   
    524   				// Store attachments to populate 'id' field via BinaryDataService
    525   				processedAttachments = await this.chatHubAttachmentService.store(
    526   					sessionId,
    527   					messageId,
    528   					attachments,
    529   				);
    530   
    531   				await this.messageRepository.createHumanMessage(
    532   					payload,
    533   					processedAttachments,
    534   					user,
    535   					previousMessageId,
    536   					model,
    537   					undefined,
    538   					trx,
    539   				);
    540   
    541   				// Resolve tool definitions from the session's join table
    542   				const tools = isNewSession
    543   					? (await this.chatHubToolService.getEnabledTools(user.id, trx)).map((t) => t.definition)
    544   					: await this.chatHubToolService.getToolDefinitionsForSession(sessionId, trx);
    545   
    546   				const replyWorkflow = await this.chatHubWorkflowService.prepareReplyWorkflow(
    547   					user,
    548   					sessionId,
    549   					credentials,
    550   					model,
    551   					history,
    552   					message,
    553   					tools,
    554   					processedAttachments,
    555   					tz,
    556   					ctx,
    557   					executionMetadata,
    558   				);
    559   
    560   				return { workflow: replyWorkflow, previousMessage };
    561   			});
    562   			workflow = result.workflow;
    563   			previousMessage = result.previousMessage;
    564   		} catch (error) {
    565   			if (processedAttachments.length > 0) {
    566   				try {
    567   					await this.chatHubAttachmentService.deleteAttachments(processedAttachments);
    568   				} catch {
    569   					this.errorReporter.warn(`Could not clean up ${processedAttachments.length} files`);
    570   				}
    571   			}
    572   
    573   			throw error;
    574   		}
    575   
    576   		if (!workflow) {
    577   			throw new UnexpectedError('Failed to prepare chat workflow.');
    578   		}
    579   
    580   		// Broadcast human message to all user connections for cross-client sync
    581   		await this.chatStreamService.sendHumanMessage({
    582   			userId: user.id,
    583   			sessionId,
    584   			messageId,
    585   			previousMessageId,
    586   			content: message,
    587   			attachments: processedAttachments.map((a) => ({
    588   				id: a.id!,
    589   				fileName: a.fileName ?? 'file',
    590   				mimeType: a.mimeType,
    591   			})),
    592   		});
    593   
    594   		const resumed = await this.tryResumeWaitingExecution({
    595   			workflow,
    596   			previousMessage,
    597   			message,
    598   			sessionId,
    599   			user,
    600   			messageId,
    601   			model,
    602   		});
    603   		if (resumed) return;
    604   
    605   		// Start the workflow execution with streaming
    606   		void this.executeChatWorkflowWithCleanup(
    607   			user,
    608   			model,
    609   			workflow,
    610   			sessionId,
    611   			messageId,
    612   			null,
    613   			previousMessageId,
    614   			credentials,
    615   			message,
    616   			processedAttachments,
    617   		);
    618   	}

    778   	/**
    779   	 * Edit a message and stream the AI response via Push events.
    780   	 * Returns immediately, streaming happens in background after.
    781   	 */
    782   	async editMessage(
    783   		user: User,
    784   		payload: EditMessagePayload,
    785   		executionMetadata: ChatHubAuthenticationMetadata,
    786   	): Promise<void> {
    787   		const { sessionId, editId, messageId, message, model, credentials, timeZone } = payload;
    788   		const tz = timeZone ?? this.globalConfig.generic.timezone;
    789   
    790   		let result: {
    791   			workflow: PreparedChatWorkflow | null;
    792   			combinedAttachments: IBinaryData[];
    793   		} | null = null;
    794   		let newStoredAttachments: IBinaryData[] = [];
    795   
    796   		try {
    797   			result = await this.messageRepository.runInTransaction({}, async (trx, ctx) => {
    798   				const session = await this.getChatSession(user, sessionId, trx);
    799   				if (!session) {
    800   					throw new NotFoundError('Chat session not found');
    801   				}
    802   
    803   				const messageToEdit = await this.getChatMessage(session.id, editId, [], trx);
    804   
    805   				if (messageToEdit.type === 'ai') {
    806   					throw new BadRequestError('Editing AI messages is not supported');
    807   				}
    808   
    809   				if (messageToEdit.type === 'human') {
    810   					const messages = Object.fromEntries((session.messages ?? []).map((m) => [m.id, m]));
    811   					const history = this.buildMessageHistory(messages, messageToEdit.previousMessageId);
    812   
    813   					const revisionOfMessageId = messageToEdit.revisionOfMessageId ?? messageToEdit.id;
    814   					const originalAttachments = messageToEdit.attachments ?? [];
    815   
    816   					const keptAttachments = payload.keepAttachmentIndices.flatMap((index) => {
    817   						const attachment = originalAttachments[index];
    818   						return attachment ? [attachment] : [];
    819   					});
    820   
    821   					newStoredAttachments =
    822   						payload.newAttachments.length > 0
    823   							? await this.chatHubAttachmentService.store(
    824   									sessionId,
    825   									messageId,
    826   									payload.newAttachments,
    827   								)
    828   							: [];
    829   
    830   					const attachments = [...keptAttachments, ...newStoredAttachments];
    831   
    832   					await this.messageRepository.createHumanMessage(
    833   						payload,
    834   						attachments,
    835   						user,
    836   						messageToEdit.previousMessageId,
    837   						model,
    838   						revisionOfMessageId,
    839   						trx,
    840   					);
    841   
    842   					const tools = await this.chatHubToolService.getToolDefinitionsForSession(sessionId, trx);
    843   
    844   					const workflow = await this.chatHubWorkflowService.prepareReplyWorkflow(
    845   						user,
    846   						sessionId,
    847   						credentials,
    848   						model,
    849   						history,
    850   						message,
    851   						tools,
    852   						attachments,
    853   						tz,
    854   						ctx,
    855   						executionMetadata,
    856   					);
    857   
    858   					return { workflow, combinedAttachments: attachments };
    859   				}
    860   
    861   				throw new BadRequestError('Only human and AI messages can be edited');
    862   			});
    863   		} catch (error) {
    864   			if (newStoredAttachments.length > 0) {
    865   				try {
    866   					await this.chatHubAttachmentService.deleteAttachments(newStoredAttachments);
    867   				} catch {
    868   					this.errorReporter.warn(`Could not clean up ${newStoredAttachments.length} files`);
    869   				}
    870   			}
    871   
    872   			throw error;
    873   		}
    874   
    875   		if (!result?.workflow) {
    876   			// AI message edit - no streaming needed
    877   			return;
    878   		}
    879   
    880   		const { workflow } = result;
    881   
    882   		// Broadcast message edit to all user connections for cross-client sync
    883   		await this.chatStreamService.sendMessageEdit({
    884   			userId: user.id,
    885   			sessionId,
    886   			revisionOfMessageId: editId,
    887   			messageId,
    888   			content: message,
    889   			attachments: result.combinedAttachments.map((a) => ({
    890   				id: a.id!,
    891   				fileName: a.fileName ?? 'file',
    892   				mimeType: a.mimeType,
    893   			})),
    894   		});
    895   
    896   		// Start the workflow execution with streaming
    897   		void this.executeChatWorkflowWithCleanup(
    898   			user,
    899   			model,
    900   			workflow,
    901   			sessionId,
    902   			messageId,
    903   			null,
    904   			null,
    905   			{},
    906   			'',
    907   			[],
    908   		);
    909   	}

	/**
	 * Deletes the user's sessions whose last message is older than the given number of days.
	 * Messages are removed through the cascade on the session foreign key.
	 */
	async deleteStaleSessions(userId: string, olderThanDays: number): Promise<number> {
		const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - olderThanDays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);

		return await this.messageRepository.manager.transaction(async (trx) => {
			const ids = await this.sessionRepository.findIdsByOwnerLastMessageBefore(
				userId,
				cutoff,
				trx,
			);
			for (const id of ids) {
				await this.chatHubAttachmentService.deleteAllBySessionId(id, trx);
			}
			await this.sessionRepository.deleteManyByIds(ids, trx);
			return ids.length;
		});
	}

    331   			current = messages[current]?.previousMessageId ?? null;
    332   		}
    333   
    334   		const history = historyIds.flatMap((id) => messages[id] ?? []);
    335   		return history;
    336   	}

    344   	/**
    345   	 * Updates a session with the provided fields
    346   	 */
    347   	async updateSession(
    348   		user: User,
    349   		sessionId: ChatSessionId,
    350   		updates: ChatHubUpdateConversationRequest,
    351   	) {
    352   		await this.ensureConversation(user.id, sessionId);
    353   
    354   		// Prepare the actual updates to be sent to the repository
    355   		const sessionUpdates: Partial<IChatHubSession> = {};
    356   
    357   		if (updates.agent) {
    358   			const model = updates.agent.model;
    359   
    360   			await this.ensureValidModel(user, model, false);
    361   
    362   			sessionUpdates.agentName = updates.agent.name;
    363   			sessionUpdates.provider = model.provider;
    364   			sessionUpdates.model = null;
    365   			sessionUpdates.credentialId = null;
    366   			sessionUpdates.agentId = null;
    367   			sessionUpdates.workflowId = null;
    368   
    369   			if (updates.agent.model.provider === 'n8n') {
    370   				sessionUpdates.workflowId = updates.agent.model.workflowId;
    371   			} else if (updates.agent.model.provider === 'custom-agent') {
    372   				sessionUpdates.agentId = updates.agent.model.agentId;
    373   			} else {
    374   				sessionUpdates.model = updates.agent.model.model;
    375   			}
    376   		}
    377   
    378   		if (updates.title !== undefined) sessionUpdates.title = updates.title;
    379   		if (updates.credentialId !== undefined) sessionUpdates.credentialId = updates.credentialId;
    380   
    381   		// One transaction: a rejected tool or a failed field update leaves the session unchanged
    382   		const { toolIds } = updates;
    383   		await this.sessionRepository.runInTransaction({}, async (trx) => {
    384   			if (toolIds !== undefined) {
    385   				await this.chatHubToolService.setSessionTools(sessionId, user.id, toolIds, trx);
    386   			}
    387   			await this.sessionRepository.updateChatSession(sessionId, sessionUpdates, trx);
    388   		});
    389   	}

    392   	 * Deletes a session

    394   	async deleteSession(userId: string, sessionId: ChatSessionId) {

    396   			await this.ensureConversation(userId, sessionId, trx);
    397   			await this.chatHubAttachmentService.deleteAllBySessionId(sessionId, trx);
    398   			await this.sessionRepository.deleteChatHubSession(sessionId, trx);
    399   		});

    403 + 	 * Deletes the user's sessions whose last message is older than the given number of days.
    404 + 	 * Messages are removed through the cascade on the session foreign key.
    405 + 	 */
    406 + 	async deleteStaleSessions(userId: string, olderThanDays: number): Promise<number> {
    407 + 		const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - olderThanDays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    408 + 
>>  409 + 		const ids = await this.sessionRepository.findIdsByOwnerLastMessageBefore(userId, cutoff);
    410 + 
    411 + 		// Attachment deletion cannot be rolled back, so it runs before the single atomic delete.
    412 + 		for (const id of ids) {
    413 + 			await this.chatHubAttachmentService.deleteAllBySessionId(id);
    414 + 		}
    415 + 		await this.sessionRepository.deleteManyByIds(ids);
    416 + 
    417 + 		return ids.length;
    418 + 	}

    420   	private async ensureValidModel(
    421   		user: User,
    422   		model: ChatHubConversationModel,
    423   		manual: boolean,
    424   		trx?: EntityManager,
    425   	) {
    426   		if (model.provider === 'custom-agent') {
    427   			// Find the agent to get its name
    428   			const agent = await this.chatHubAgentService.getAgentById(model.agentId, user.id, trx);
    429   			if (!agent) {
    430   				throw new BadRequestError('Agent not found for chat session initialization');
    431   			}
    432   		}
    433   
    434   		if (model.provider === 'n8n') {
    435   			// Find the workflow to get its name
    436   			const workflowEntity = await this.workflowFinderService.findWorkflowForUser(
    437   				model.workflowId,
    438   				user,
    439   				['workflow:execute-chat'],
    440   				{
    441   					includeTags: false,
    442   					includeParentFolder: false,
    443   					includeActiveVersion: manual ? false : true,
    444   					em: trx,
    445   				},
    446   			);
    447   
    448   			if (!workflowEntity) {
    449   				throw new BadRequestError('Workflow not found for chat session initialization');
    450   			}
    451   
    452   			// In manual mode, validate against draft nodes; otherwise use activeVersion
    453   			const nodes = manual ? workflowEntity.nodes : workflowEntity.activeVersion?.nodes;
    454   
    455   			if (!nodes) {
    456   				throw new BadRequestError('Workflow not found for chat session initialization');
    457   			}
    458   
    459   			const chatTrigger = nodes.find((node) => node.type === CHAT_TRIGGER_NODE_TYPE);
    460   
    461   			if (!chatTrigger) {
    462   				throw new BadRequestError(
    463   					'Chat trigger not found in workflow for chat session initialization',
    464   				);
    465   			}
    466   		}
    467   	}

    469   	/**
    470   	 * Send a human message and stream the AI response via Push events.
    471   	 * Returns immediately, streaming happens in background after.
    472   	 */
    473   	async sendHumanMessage(
    474   		user: User,
    475   		payload: HumanMessagePayload,
    476   		executionMetadata: ChatHubAuthenticationMetadata,
    477   	): Promise<void> {
    478   		const {
    479   			sessionId,
    480   			messageId,
    481   			message,
    482   			model,
    483   			credentials,
    484   			previousMessageId,
    485   			attachments,
    486   			timeZone,
    487   		} = payload;
    488   		const tz = timeZone ?? this.globalConfig.generic.timezone;
    489   
    490   		const credentialId = this.getModelCredential(model, credentials);
    491   
    492   		let processedAttachments: IBinaryData[] = [];
    493   		let workflow: PreparedChatWorkflow;
    494   		let previousMessage: ChatHubMessage | undefined;
    495   
    496   		try {
    497   			const result = await this.messageRepository.runInTransaction({}, async (trx, ctx) => {
    498   				let session = await this.getChatSession(user, sessionId, trx);
    499   				const isNewSession = !session;
    500   				session ??= await this.createChatSession(
    501   					user,
    502   					sessionId,
    503   					model,
    504   					credentialId,
    505   					false,
    506   					payload.agentName,
    507   					trx,
    508   				);
    509   
    510   				const previousMessage = await this.ensurePreviousMessage(previousMessageId, sessionId, trx);
    511   				const messages = Object.fromEntries((session.messages ?? []).map((m) => [m.id, m]));
    512   				const history = this.buildMessageHistory(messages, previousMessageId);
    513   
    514   				// Validate attachments against the model's upload policy before storing
    515   				if (attachments.length > 0) {
    516   					const policy = await this.chatHubWorkflowService.getAttachmentPolicy(model, user, trx);
    517   					this.chatHubAttachmentService.validateAttachments(
    518   						attachments,
    519   						policy.allowFileUploads,
    520   						policy.allowedFilesMimeTypes,
    521   					);
    522   				}
    523   
    524   				// Store attachments to populate 'id' field via BinaryDataService
    525   				processedAttachments = await this.chatHubAttachmentService.store(
    526   					sessionId,
    527   					messageId,
    528   					attachments,
    529   				);
    530   
    531   				await this.messageRepository.createHumanMessage(
    532   					payload,
    533   					processedAttachments,
    534   					user,
    535   					previousMessageId,
    536   					model,
    537   					undefined,
    538   					trx,
    539   				);
    540   
    541   				// Resolve tool definitions from the session's join table
    542   				const tools = isNewSession
    543   					? (await this.chatHubToolService.getEnabledTools(user.id, trx)).map((t) => t.definition)
    544   					: await this.chatHubToolService.getToolDefinitionsForSession(sessionId, trx);
    545   
    546   				const replyWorkflow = await this.chatHubWorkflowService.prepareReplyWorkflow(
    547   					user,
    548   					sessionId,
    549   					credentials,
    550   					model,
    551   					history,
    552   					message,
    553   					tools,
    554   					processedAttachments,
    555   					tz,
    556   					ctx,
    557   					executionMetadata,
    558   				);
    559   
    560   				return { workflow: replyWorkflow, previousMessage };
    561   			});
    562   			workflow = result.workflow;
    563   			previousMessage = result.previousMessage;
    564   		} catch (error) {
    565   			if (processedAttachments.length > 0) {
    566   				try {
    567   					await this.chatHubAttachmentService.deleteAttachments(processedAttachments);
    568   				} catch {
    569   					this.errorReporter.warn(`Could not clean up ${processedAttachments.length} files`);
    570   				}
    571   			}
    572   
    573   			throw error;
    574   		}
    575   
    576   		if (!workflow) {
    577   			throw new UnexpectedError('Failed to prepare chat workflow.');
    578   		}
    579   
    580   		// Broadcast human message to all user connections for cross-client sync
    581   		await this.chatStreamService.sendHumanMessage({
    582   			userId: user.id,
    583   			sessionId,
    584   			messageId,
    585   			previousMessageId,
    586   			content: message,
    587   			attachments: processedAttachments.map((a) => ({
    588   				id: a.id!,
    589   				fileName: a.fileName ?? 'file',
    590   				mimeType: a.mimeType,
    591   			})),
    592   		});
    593   
    594   		const resumed = await this.tryResumeWaitingExecution({
    595   			workflow,
    596   			previousMessage,
    597   			message,
    598   			sessionId,
    599   			user,
    600   			messageId,
    601   			model,
    602   		});
    603   		if (resumed) return;
    604   
    605   		// Start the workflow execution with streaming
    606   		void this.executeChatWorkflowWithCleanup(
    607   			user,
    608   			model,
    609   			workflow,
    610   			sessionId,
    611   			messageId,
    612   			null,
    613   			previousMessageId,
    614   			credentials,
    615   			message,
    616   			processedAttachments,
    617   		);
    618   	}

    779   	 * Edit a message and stream the AI response via Push events.

    782   	async editMessage(
    783   		user: User,
    784   		payload: EditMessagePayload,
    785   		executionMetadata: ChatHubAuthenticationMetadata,
    786   	): Promise<void> {
    787   		const { sessionId, editId, messageId, message, model, credentials, timeZone } = payload;
    788   		const tz = timeZone ?? this.globalConfig.generic.timezone;
    789   
    790   		let result: {
    791   			workflow: PreparedChatWorkflow | null;
    792   			combinedAttachments: IBinaryData[];
    793   		} | null = null;
    794   		let newStoredAttachments: IBinaryData[] = [];
    795   
    796   		try {
    797   			result = await this.messageRepository.runInTransaction({}, async (trx, ctx) => {
    798   				const session = await this.getChatSession(user, sessionId, trx);
    799   				if (!session) {
    800   					throw new NotFoundError('Chat session not found');
    801   				}
    802   
    803   				const messageToEdit = await this.getChatMessage(session.id, editId, [], trx);
    804   
    805   				if (messageToEdit.type === 'ai') {
    806   					throw new BadRequestError('Editing AI messages is not supported');
    807   				}
    808   
    809   				if (messageToEdit.type === 'human') {
    810   					const messages = Object.fromEntries((session.messages ?? []).map((m) => [m.id, m]));
    811   					const history = this.buildMessageHistory(messages, messageToEdit.previousMessageId);
    812   
    813   					const revisionOfMessageId = messageToEdit.revisionOfMessageId ?? messageToEdit.id;
    814   					const originalAttachments = messageToEdit.attachments ?? [];
    815   
    816   					const keptAttachments = payload.keepAttachmentIndices.flatMap((index) => {
    817   						const attachment = originalAttachments[index];
    818   						return attachment ? [attachment] : [];
    819   					});
    820   
    821   					newStoredAttachments =
    822   						payload.newAttachments.length > 0
    823   							? await this.chatHubAttachmentService.store(
    824   									sessionId,
    825   									messageId,
    826   									payload.newAttachments,
    827   								)
    828   							: [];
    829   
    830   					const attachments = [...keptAttachments, ...newStoredAttachments];
    831   
    832   					await this.messageRepository.createHumanMessage(
    833   						payload,
    834   						attachments,
    835   						user,
    836   						messageToEdit.previousMessageId,
    837   						model,
    838   						revisionOfMessageId,
    839   						trx,
    840   					);
    841   
    842   					const tools = await this.chatHubToolService.getToolDefinitionsForSession(sessionId, trx);
    843   
    844   					const workflow = await this.chatHubWorkflowService.prepareReplyWorkflow(
    845   						user,
    846   						sessionId,
    847   						credentials,
    848   						model,
    849   						history,
    850   						message,
    851   						tools,
    852   						attachments,
    853   						tz,
    854   						ctx,
    855   						executionMetadata,
    856   					);
    857   
    858   					return { workflow, combinedAttachments: attachments };
    859   				}
    860   
    861   				throw new BadRequestError('Only human and AI messages can be edited');
    862   			});
    863   		} catch (error) {
    864   			if (newStoredAttachments.length > 0) {
    865   				try {
    866   					await this.chatHubAttachmentService.deleteAttachments(newStoredAttachments);
    867   				} catch {
    868   					this.errorReporter.warn(`Could not clean up ${newStoredAttachments.length} files`);
    869   				}
    870   			}
    871   
    872   			throw error;

    875   		if (!result?.workflow) {

    881

    883   		await this.chatStreamService.sendMessageEdit({

    886   			revisionOfMessageId: editId,
    887   			messageId,
    888   			content: message,
    889   			attachments: result.combinedAttachments.map((a) => ({
    890   				id: a.id!,
    891   				fileName: a.fileName ?? 'file',
    892   				mimeType: a.mimeType,
    893   			})),
    894   		});
    895   
    896   		// Start the workflow execution with streaming
    897   		void this.executeChatWorkflowWithCleanup(
    898   			user,
    899   			model,
    900   			workflow,
    901   			sessionId,
    902   			messageId,
    903   			null,

} from './GenericFunctions';

// Member status for an invitation that the member has not accepted yet.
const INVITED_MEMBER_STATUS = 0;

/**
 * Resend the invitation to every member whose invitation is still pending.
 * Returns one item per pending member. A failed resend does not stop the others.
 */
async function resendPendingMemberInvites(
	this: IExecuteFunctions,
	token: string,
): Promise<INodeExecutionData[]> {
	const response = await tokenlessBitwardenApiRequest.call(
		this,
		'GET',
		'/public/members',
		{},
		{},
		token,
	);

	const pendingMembers = (
		response.data as Array<{ id: string; email: string; status: number }>
	).filter((member) => member.status === INVITED_MEMBER_STATUS);

	if (pendingMembers.length === 0) {
		throw new NodeOperationError(
			this.getNode(),
			'The organization has no pending members. There are no invitations to resend.',
		);
	}

	const results: IDataObject[] = [];

	for (const member of pendingMembers) {
		try {
			await tokenlessBitwardenApiRequest.call(
				this,
				'POST',
				`/public/members/${member.id}/reinvite`,
				{},
				{},
				token,
			);
			results.push({ email: member.email, success: true });
		} catch (error) {
			results.push({ email: member.email, success: false, error: (error as Error).message });
		}
	}

	return this.helpers.returnJsonArray(results);
}

    518   			}
    519

    524   		return binaryItems.length > 0 ? [binaryItems] : [this.helpers.returnJsonArray(returnData)];

     84   
     85   		return credentials[PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_TYPE_MAP[provider]]?.id ?? null;
     86   	}

     88   	private async ensurePreviousMessage(
     89   		previousMessageId: ChatMessageId | null,
     90   		sessionId: string,
     91   		trx?: EntityManager,
     92   	) {
     93   		if (!previousMessageId) {
     94   			return;
     95   		}
     96   
     97   		const previousMessage = await this.messageRepository.getOneById(
     98   			previousMessageId,
     99   			sessionId,
    100   			[],
    101   			trx,
    102   		);
    103   		if (!previousMessage) {
    104   			throw new BadRequestError('The previous message does not exist in the session');
    105   		}
    106   
    107   		return previousMessage;
    108   	}
