    110   	/**
    111   	 * If the previous message is in 'waiting' state (e.g. Chat node waiting for user input),
    112   	 * resume the waiting execution instead of starting a new one. Returns true if resumed.
    113   	 */
    114   	private async tryResumeWaitingExecution(opts: {
    115   		workflow: PreparedChatWorkflow;
    116   		previousMessage: ChatHubMessage | undefined;
    117   		message: string;
    118   		sessionId: ChatSessionId;
    119   		user: User;
    120   		messageId: ChatMessageId;
    121   		model: ChatHubConversationModel;
    122   	}): Promise<boolean> {
    123   		const { workflow, previousMessage, message, sessionId, user, messageId, model } = opts;
    124   
    125   		if (
    126   			model.provider !== 'n8n' ||
    127   			workflow.responseMode !== 'responseNodes' ||
    128   			previousMessage?.status !== 'waiting' ||
    129   			!previousMessage?.executionId
    130   		) {
    131   			return false;
    132   		}
    133   
    134   		const execution = await this.executionPersistence.findSingleExecution(
    135   			previousMessage.executionId.toString(),
    136   			{
    137   				includeData: true,
    138   				unflattenData: true,
    139   			},
    140   		);
    141   		if (!execution) {
    142   			throw new OperationalError('Chat session has expired.');
    143   		}
    144   
    145   		// Only resume nodes a chat message is meant to drive (see
    146   		// ChatExecutionManager.canResumeOverChat) — the same allowlist the chat
    147   		// websocket uses. A workflow parked on, e.g., a Send-and-Wait approval gate
    148   		// must not be advanced by the next chat message; refuse before any state
    149   		// changes so the gate stays waiting for its real responder.
    150   		if (!this.executionManager.canResumeOverChat(execution)) {
    151   			this.logger.warn(
    152   				`Refused chat-hub resume for execution ${execution.id}: suspended node is not resumable over chat`,
    153   			);
    154   			throw new BadRequestError(
    155   				'This conversation is waiting for a response that cannot be provided from chat.',
    156   			);
    157   		}
    158   
    159   		this.logger.debug(
    160   			`Resuming execution ${execution.id} from waiting state for session ${sessionId}`,
    161   		);
    162   
    163   		await this.messageRepository.updateChatMessage(previousMessage.id, {
    164   			status: 'success',
    165   		});
    166   
    167   		void this.chatHubExecutionService.resumeChatExecution(
    168   			execution,
    169   			message,
    170   			sessionId,
    171   			user,
    172   			messageId,
    173   			model,
    174   			workflow.responseMode,
    175   		);
    176   		return true;
    177   	}

    179   	async stopGeneration(user: User, sessionId: ChatSessionId, messageId: ChatMessageId) {
    180   		await this.ensureConversation(user.id, sessionId);
    181   
    182   		const message = await this.getChatMessage(sessionId, messageId, [
    183   			'execution',
    184   			'execution.workflow',
    185   		]);
    186   
    187   		if (message.type !== 'ai') {
    188   			throw new BadRequestError('Can only stop AI messages');
    189   		}
    190   
    191   		if (!message.executionId || !message.execution) {
    192   			throw new BadRequestError('Message is not associated with a workflow execution');
    193   		}
    194   
    195   		if (message.status !== 'running') {
    196   			throw new BadRequestError('Can only stop messages that are currently running');
    197   		}
    198   
    199   		await this.chatHubExecutionService.stop(message.execution.id, message.execution.workflowId);
    200   		await this.messageRepository.updateChatMessage(messageId, { status: 'cancelled' });
    201   	}

    214   	private async createChatSession(
    215   		user: User,
    216   		sessionId: ChatSessionId,
    217   		model: ChatHubConversationModel,
    218   		credentialId: string | null,
    219   		manual: boolean,
    220   		agentName?: string,

    223   		await this.ensureValidModel(user, model, manual, trx);

    225   		const session = await this.sessionRepository.createChatSession(

    236   			trx,

    239   		// Populate session tools from enabled configured tools

    242   		if (toolIds.length > 0) {
    243   			await this.chatHubToolService.setSessionTools(sessionId, user.id, toolIds, trx);
    244   		}

    262   	/**
    263   	 * Get all conversations for a user
    264   	 */
    265   	async getConversations(
    266   		userId: string,
    267   		limit: number,
    268   		cursor?: string,
    269   		type?: string,
    270   	): Promise<ChatHubConversationsResponse> {
    271   		const sessions = await this.sessionRepository.getManyByUserId(userId, limit + 1, cursor, type);
    272   
    273   		const hasMore = sessions.length > limit;
    274   		const data = hasMore ? sessions.slice(0, limit) : sessions;
    275   		const nextCursor = hasMore ? data[data.length - 1].id : null;
    276   
    277   		return {
    278   			data: data.map((session) => this.convertSessionEntityToDto(session)),
    279   			nextCursor,
    280   			hasMore,
    281   		};
    282   	}

    296   	 * */
    297   	async getConversation(userId: string, sessionId: string): Promise<ChatHubConversationResponse> {

    299   		if (!session) {

    304   		const toolIds = await this.chatHubToolService.getToolIdsForSession(sessionId);
    305   
    306   		return {
    307   			session: this.convertSessionEntityToDto(session, toolIds),
    308   			conversation: {
    309   				messages: Object.fromEntries(messages.map((m) => [m.id, this.convertMessageToDto(m)])),
    310   			},
    311   		};

    314   	/**
    315   	 * Build the message history chain ending to the message with ID `lastMessageId`
    316   	 */
    317   	private buildMessageHistory(
    318   		messages: Record<ChatMessageId, ChatHubMessage>,
    319   		lastMessageId: ChatMessageId | null,
    320   	) {
    321   		if (!lastMessageId) return [];
    322   
    323   		const visited = new Set<string>();
    324   		const historyIds = [];
    325   
    326   		let current: ChatMessageId | null = lastMessageId;
    327   
    328   		while (current && !visited.has(current)) {
    329   			historyIds.unshift(current);
    330   			visited.add(current);
    331   			current = messages[current]?.previousMessageId ?? null;
    332   		}
    333   
    334   		const history = historyIds.flatMap((id) => messages[id] ?? []);
    335   		return history;
    336   	}

    344   	/**
    345   	 * Updates a session with the provided fields
    346   	 */
    347   	async updateSession(
    348   		user: User,
    349   		sessionId: ChatSessionId,
    350   		updates: ChatHubUpdateConversationRequest,
    351   	) {
    352   		await this.ensureConversation(user.id, sessionId);
    353   
    354   		// Prepare the actual updates to be sent to the repository
    355   		const sessionUpdates: Partial<IChatHubSession> = {};
    356   
    357   		if (updates.agent) {
    358   			const model = updates.agent.model;
    359   
    360   			await this.ensureValidModel(user, model, false);
    361   
    362   			sessionUpdates.agentName = updates.agent.name;
    363   			sessionUpdates.provider = model.provider;
    364   			sessionUpdates.model = null;
    365   			sessionUpdates.credentialId = null;
    366   			sessionUpdates.agentId = null;
    367   			sessionUpdates.workflowId = null;
    368   
    369   			if (updates.agent.model.provider === 'n8n') {
    370   				sessionUpdates.workflowId = updates.agent.model.workflowId;
    371   			} else if (updates.agent.model.provider === 'custom-agent') {
    372   				sessionUpdates.agentId = updates.agent.model.agentId;
    373   			} else {
    374   				sessionUpdates.model = updates.agent.model.model;
    375   			}
    376   		}
    377   
    378   		if (updates.title !== undefined) sessionUpdates.title = updates.title;
    379   		if (updates.credentialId !== undefined) sessionUpdates.credentialId = updates.credentialId;
    380   
    381   		// One transaction: a rejected tool or a failed field update leaves the session unchanged
    382   		const { toolIds } = updates;
    383   		await this.sessionRepository.runInTransaction({}, async (trx) => {
    384   			if (toolIds !== undefined) {
    385   				await this.chatHubToolService.setSessionTools(sessionId, user.id, toolIds, trx);
    386   			}
    387   			await this.sessionRepository.updateChatSession(sessionId, sessionUpdates, trx);
    388   		});
    389   	}

    391   	/**
    392   	 * Deletes a session
    393   	 */
    394   	async deleteSession(userId: string, sessionId: ChatSessionId) {

    396   			await this.ensureConversation(userId, sessionId, trx);
    397   			await this.chatHubAttachmentService.deleteAllBySessionId(sessionId, trx);
    398   			await this.sessionRepository.deleteChatHubSession(sessionId, trx);
    399   		});
    400   	}

    425   	private async ensureValidModel(
    426   		user: User,
    427   		model: ChatHubConversationModel,
    428   		manual: boolean,
    429   		trx?: EntityManager,
    430   	) {
    431   		if (model.provider === 'custom-agent') {
    432   			// Find the agent to get its name
    433   			const agent = await this.chatHubAgentService.getAgentById(model.agentId, user.id, trx);
    434   			if (!agent) {
    435   				throw new BadRequestError('Agent not found for chat session initialization');
    436   			}
    437   		}
    438   
    439   		if (model.provider === 'n8n') {
    440   			// Find the workflow to get its name
    441   			const workflowEntity = await this.workflowFinderService.findWorkflowForUser(
    442   				model.workflowId,
    443   				user,
    444   				['workflow:execute-chat'],
    445   				{
    446   					includeTags: false,
    447   					includeParentFolder: false,
    448   					includeActiveVersion: manual ? false : true,
    449   					em: trx,
    450   				},
    451   			);
    452   
    453   			if (!workflowEntity) {
    454   				throw new BadRequestError('Workflow not found for chat session initialization');
    455   			}
    456   
    457   			// In manual mode, validate against draft nodes; otherwise use activeVersion
    458   			const nodes = manual ? workflowEntity.nodes : workflowEntity.activeVersion?.nodes;
    459   
    460   			if (!nodes) {
    461   				throw new BadRequestError('Workflow not found for chat session initialization');
    462   			}
    463   
    464   			const chatTrigger = nodes.find((node) => node.type === CHAT_TRIGGER_NODE_TYPE);
    465   
    466   			if (!chatTrigger) {
    467   				throw new BadRequestError(
    468   					'Chat trigger not found in workflow for chat session initialization',
    469   				);
    470   			}
    471   		}
    472   	}

    474   	/**
    475   	 * Send a human message and stream the AI response via Push events.
    476   	 * Returns immediately, streaming happens in background after.
    477   	 */
    478   	async sendHumanMessage(
    479   		user: User,
    480   		payload: HumanMessagePayload,
    481   		executionMetadata: ChatHubAuthenticationMetadata,
    482   	): Promise<void> {
    483   		const {
    484   			sessionId,
    485   			messageId,
    486   			message,
    487   			model,
    488   			credentials,
    489   			previousMessageId,
    490   			attachments,
    491   			timeZone,
    492   		} = payload;
    493   		const tz = timeZone ?? this.globalConfig.generic.timezone;
    494   
    495   		const credentialId = this.getModelCredential(model, credentials);
    496   
    497   		let processedAttachments: IBinaryData[] = [];
    498   		let workflow: PreparedChatWorkflow;
    499   		let previousMessage: ChatHubMessage | undefined;
    500   
    501   		try {
    502   			const result = await this.messageRepository.runInTransaction({}, async (trx, ctx) => {
    503   				let session = await this.getChatSession(user, sessionId, trx);
    504   				const isNewSession = !session;
    505   				session ??= await this.createChatSession(
    506   					user,
    507   					sessionId,
    508   					model,
    509   					credentialId,
    510   					false,
    511   					payload.agentName,
    512   					trx,
    513   				);
    514   
    515   				const previousMessage = await this.ensurePreviousMessage(previousMessageId, sessionId, trx);
    516   				const messages = Object.fromEntries((session.messages ?? []).map((m) => [m.id, m]));
    517   				const history = this.buildMessageHistory(messages, previousMessageId);
    518   
    519   				// Validate attachments against the model's upload policy before storing
    520   				if (attachments.length > 0) {
    521   					const policy = await this.chatHubWorkflowService.getAttachmentPolicy(model, user, trx);
    522   					this.chatHubAttachmentService.validateAttachments(
    523   						attachments,
    524   						policy.allowFileUploads,
    525   						policy.allowedFilesMimeTypes,
    526   					);
    527   				}
    528   
    529   				// Store attachments to populate 'id' field via BinaryDataService
    530   				processedAttachments = await this.chatHubAttachmentService.store(
    531   					sessionId,
    532   					messageId,
    533   					attachments,
    534   				);
    535   
    536   				await this.messageRepository.createHumanMessage(
    537   					payload,
    538   					processedAttachments,
    539   					user,
    540   					previousMessageId,
    541   					model,
    542   					undefined,
    543   					trx,
    544   				);
    545   
    546   				// Resolve tool definitions from the session's join table
    547   				const tools = isNewSession
    548   					? (await this.chatHubToolService.getEnabledTools(user.id, trx)).map((t) => t.definition)
    549   					: await this.chatHubToolService.getToolDefinitionsForSession(sessionId, trx);
    550   
    551   				const replyWorkflow = await this.chatHubWorkflowService.prepareReplyWorkflow(
    552   					user,
    553   					sessionId,
    554   					credentials,
    555   					model,
    556   					history,
    557   					message,
    558   					tools,
    559   					processedAttachments,
    560   					tz,
    561   					ctx,
    562   					executionMetadata,
    563   				);
    564   
    565   				return { workflow: replyWorkflow, previousMessage };
    566   			});
    567   			workflow = result.workflow;
    568   			previousMessage = result.previousMessage;
    569   		} catch (error) {
    570   			if (processedAttachments.length > 0) {
    571   				try {
    572   					await this.chatHubAttachmentService.deleteAttachments(processedAttachments);
    573   				} catch {
    574   					this.errorReporter.warn(`Could not clean up ${processedAttachments.length} files`);
    575   				}
    576   			}
    577   
    578   			throw error;
    579   		}
    580   
    581   		if (!workflow) {
    582   			throw new UnexpectedError('Failed to prepare chat workflow.');
    583   		}
    584   
    585   		// Broadcast human message to all user connections for cross-client sync
    586   		await this.chatStreamService.sendHumanMessage({
    587   			userId: user.id,
    588   			sessionId,
    589   			messageId,
    590   			previousMessageId,
    591   			content: message,
    592   			attachments: processedAttachments.map((a) => ({
    593   				id: a.id!,
    594   				fileName: a.fileName ?? 'file',
    595   				mimeType: a.mimeType,
    596   			})),
    597   		});
    598   
    599   		const resumed = await this.tryResumeWaitingExecution({
    600   			workflow,
    601   			previousMessage,
    602   			message,
    603   			sessionId,
    604   			user,
    605   			messageId,
    606   			model,
    607   		});
    608   		if (resumed) return;
    609   
    610   		// Start the workflow execution with streaming
    611   		void this.executeChatWorkflowWithCleanup(
    612   			user,
    613   			model,
    614   			workflow,
    615   			sessionId,
    616   			messageId,
    617   			null,
    618   			previousMessageId,
    619   			credentials,
    620   			message,
    621   			processedAttachments,
    622   		);
    623   	}

    625   	/**

    629   	async sendHumanMessageManual(

    679   						true,

    681   					this.chatHubAttachmentService.validateAttachments(

    683   						policy.allowFileUploads,

    686   				}
    687   
    688   				processedAttachments = await this.chatHubAttachmentService.store(
    689   					sessionId,

    693   
    694   				await this.messageRepository.createHumanMessage(
    695   					payload,
    696   					processedAttachments,
    697   					user,
    698   					previousMessageId,
    699   					model,
    700   					undefined,
    701   					trx,
    702   				);
    703   
    704   				// Manual mode only supports n8n provider — workflow has its own tools
    705   				const tools: INode[] = [];
    706   
    707   				const replyWorkflow = await this.chatHubWorkflowService.prepareReplyWorkflow(
    708   					user,
    709   					sessionId,
    710   					credentials,
    711   					model,
    712   					history,
    713   					message,
    714   					tools,
    715   					processedAttachments,
    716   					tz,
    717   					ctx,
    718   					executionMetadata,
    719   					true, // manual
    720   				);
    721   
    722   				return { workflow: replyWorkflow, previousMessage };
    723   			});
    724   			workflow = result.workflow;
    725   			previousMessage = result.previousMessage;
    726   		} catch (error) {
    727   			if (processedAttachments.length > 0) {
    728   				try {
    729   					await this.chatHubAttachmentService.deleteAttachments(processedAttachments);
    730   				} catch {
    731   					this.errorReporter.warn(`Could not clean up ${processedAttachments.length} files`);
    732   				}
    733   			}
    734   
    735   			throw error;
    736   		}
    737   
    738   		if (!workflow) {
    739   			throw new UnexpectedError('Failed to prepare chat workflow.');
    740   		}
    741   
    742   		// Broadcast human message to all user connections for cross-client sync
    743   		await this.chatStreamService.sendHumanMessage({
    744   			userId: user.id,
    745   			sessionId,
    746   			messageId,
    747   			previousMessageId,
    748   			content: message,
    749   			attachments: processedAttachments.map((a) => ({
    750   				id: a.id!,
    751   				fileName: a.fileName ?? 'file',
    752   				mimeType: a.mimeType,
    753   			})),
    754   		});
    755   
    756   		const resumed = await this.tryResumeWaitingExecution({
    757   			workflow,
    758   			previousMessage,
    759   			message,
    760   			sessionId,
    761   			user,
    762   			messageId,
    763   			model,
    764   		});
    765   		if (resumed) return;
    766   
    767   		// Start the workflow execution with pushRef for canvas events
    768   		void this.executeChatWorkflowWithCleanup(
    769   			user,
    770   			model,
    771   			workflow,
    772   			sessionId,
    773   			messageId,
    774   			null,
    775   			previousMessageId,
    776   			credentials,
    777   			message,
    778   			processedAttachments,
    779   			pushRef,
    780   		);
    781   	}

    783   	/**
    784   	 * Edit a message and stream the AI response via Push events.
    785   	 * Returns immediately, streaming happens in background after.
    786   	 */
    787   	async editMessage(
    788   		user: User,
    789   		payload: EditMessagePayload,
    790   		executionMetadata: ChatHubAuthenticationMetadata,
    791   	): Promise<void> {
    792   		const { sessionId, editId, messageId, message, model, credentials, timeZone } = payload;
    793   		const tz = timeZone ?? this.globalConfig.generic.timezone;
    794   
    795   		let result: {
    796   			workflow: PreparedChatWorkflow | null;
    797   			combinedAttachments: IBinaryData[];
    798   		} | null = null;
    799   		let newStoredAttachments: IBinaryData[] = [];
    800   
    801   		try {
    802   			result = await this.messageRepository.runInTransaction({}, async (trx, ctx) => {
    803   				const session = await this.getChatSession(user, sessionId, trx);
    804   				if (!session) {
    805   					throw new NotFoundError('Chat session not found');
    806   				}
    807   
    808   				const messageToEdit = await this.getChatMessage(session.id, editId, [], trx);
    809   
    810   				if (messageToEdit.type === 'ai') {
    811   					throw new BadRequestError('Editing AI messages is not supported');
    812   				}
    813   
    814   				if (messageToEdit.type === 'human') {
    815   					const messages = Object.fromEntries((session.messages ?? []).map((m) => [m.id, m]));
    816   					const history = this.buildMessageHistory(messages, messageToEdit.previousMessageId);
    817   
    818   					const revisionOfMessageId = messageToEdit.revisionOfMessageId ?? messageToEdit.id;
    819   					const originalAttachments = messageToEdit.attachments ?? [];
    820   
    821   					const keptAttachments = payload.keepAttachmentIndices.flatMap((index) => {
    822   						const attachment = originalAttachments[index];
    823   						return attachment ? [attachment] : [];
    824   					});
    825   
    826   					newStoredAttachments =
    827   						payload.newAttachments.length > 0
    828   							? await this.chatHubAttachmentService.store(
    829   									sessionId,
    830   									messageId,
    831   									payload.newAttachments,
    832   								)
    833   							: [];
    834   
    835   					const attachments = [...keptAttachments, ...newStoredAttachments];
    836   
    837   					await this.messageRepository.createHumanMessage(
    838   						payload,
    839   						attachments,
    840   						user,
    841   						messageToEdit.previousMessageId,
    842   						model,
    843   						revisionOfMessageId,
    844   						trx,
    845   					);
    846   
    847   					const tools = await this.chatHubToolService.getToolDefinitionsForSession(sessionId, trx);
    848   
    849   					const workflow = await this.chatHubWorkflowService.prepareReplyWorkflow(
    850   						user,
    851   						sessionId,
    852   						credentials,
    853   						model,
    854   						history,
    855   						message,
    856   						tools,
    857   						attachments,
    858   						tz,
    859   						ctx,
    860   						executionMetadata,
    861   					);
    862   
    863   					return { workflow, combinedAttachments: attachments };
    864   				}
    865   
    866   				throw new BadRequestError('Only human and AI messages can be edited');
    867   			});
    868   		} catch (error) {
    869   			if (newStoredAttachments.length > 0) {
    870   				try {
    871   					await this.chatHubAttachmentService.deleteAttachments(newStoredAttachments);
    872   				} catch {
    873   					this.errorReporter.warn(`Could not clean up ${newStoredAttachments.length} files`);
    874   				}
    875   			}
    876   
    877   			throw error;
    878   		}
    879   
    880   		if (!result?.workflow) {
    881   			// AI message edit - no streaming needed
    882   			return;
    883   		}
    884   
    885   		const { workflow } = result;
    886   
    887   		// Broadcast message edit to all user connections for cross-client sync
    888   		await this.chatStreamService.sendMessageEdit({
    889   			userId: user.id,
    890   			sessionId,
    891   			revisionOfMessageId: editId,
    892   			messageId,
    893   			content: message,
    894   			attachments: result.combinedAttachments.map((a) => ({
    895   				id: a.id!,
    896   				fileName: a.fileName ?? 'file',
    897   				mimeType: a.mimeType,
    898   			})),
    899   		});
    900   
    901   		// Start the workflow execution with streaming
    902   		void this.executeChatWorkflowWithCleanup(
    903   			user,
    904   			model,
    905   			workflow,
    906   			sessionId,
    907   			messageId,
    908   			null,
    909   			null,
    910   			{},
    911   			'',
    912   			[],
    913   		);
    914   	}

   1071   	/**
   1072   	 * Regenerate an AI message and stream via Push events.
   1073   	 * Returns immediately; streaming happens in background.
   1074   	 */
   1075   	async regenerateAIMessage(
   1076   		user: User,
   1077   		payload: RegenerateMessagePayload,
   1078   		executionMetadata: ChatHubAuthenticationMetadata,
   1079   	): Promise<void> {
   1080   		const { sessionId, retryId, model, credentials, timeZone } = payload;
   1081   		const tz = timeZone ?? this.globalConfig.generic.timezone;
   1082   
   1083   		const { retryOfMessageId, previousMessageId, workflow } =
   1084   			await this.messageRepository.runInTransaction({}, async (trx, ctx) => {
   1085   				const session = await this.getChatSession(user, sessionId, trx);
   1086   				if (!session) {
   1087   					throw new NotFoundError('Chat session not found');
   1088   				}
   1089   
   1090   				const messageToRetry = await this.getChatMessage(session.id, retryId, [], trx);
   1091   
   1092   				if (messageToRetry.type !== 'ai') {
   1093   					throw new BadRequestError('Can only retry AI messages');
   1094   				}
   1095   
   1096   				const messages = Object.fromEntries((session.messages ?? []).map((m) => [m.id, m]));
   1097   				const history = this.buildMessageHistory(messages, messageToRetry.previousMessageId);
   1098   
   1099   				const lastHumanMessage = history.filter((m) => m.type === 'human').pop();
   1100   				if (!lastHumanMessage) {
   1101   					throw new BadRequestError('No human message found to base the retry on');
   1102   				}
   1103   
   1104   				const lastHumanMessageIndex = history.indexOf(lastHumanMessage);
   1105   				if (lastHumanMessageIndex !== -1) {
   1106   					history.splice(lastHumanMessageIndex);
   1107   				}
   1108   
   1109   				const retryOfMessageId = messageToRetry.retryOfMessageId ?? messageToRetry.id;
   1110   				const message = lastHumanMessage ? lastHumanMessage.content : '';
   1111   				const attachments = lastHumanMessage.attachments ?? [];
   1112   
   1113   				const tools = await this.chatHubToolService.getToolDefinitionsForSession(sessionId, trx);
   1114   
   1115   				const workflow = await this.chatHubWorkflowService.prepareReplyWorkflow(
   1116   					user,
   1117   					sessionId,
   1118   					credentials,
   1119   					model,
   1120   					history,
   1121   					message,
   1122   					tools,
   1123   					attachments,
   1124   					tz,
   1125   					ctx,
   1126   					executionMetadata,
   1127   				);
   1128   
   1129   				return {
   1130   					previousMessageId: lastHumanMessage.id,
   1131   					retryOfMessageId,
   1132   					workflow,
   1133   				};
   1134   			});
   1135   
   1136   		// Start the workflow execution with streaming (fire and forget)
   1137   		void this.executeChatWorkflowWithCleanup(
   1138   			user,
   1139   			model,
   1140   			workflow,
   1141   			sessionId,
   1142   			previousMessageId,
   1143   			retryOfMessageId,
   1144   			null,
   1145   			{},
   1146   			'',
   1147   			[],
   1148   		);
   1149   	}

   1239   	/**
   1240   	 * Reconnect to an active chat stream
   1241   	 * Returns pending chunks that the client may have missed
   1242   	 */
   1243   	async reconnectToStream(
   1244   		sessionId: ChatSessionId,
   1245   		lastReceivedSequence: number,
   1246   	): Promise<{
   1247   		hasActiveStream: boolean;
   1248   		currentMessageId: ChatMessageId | null;
   1249   		pendingChunks: Array<{ sequenceNumber: number; content: string }>;
   1250   		lastSequenceNumber: number;
   1251   	}> {
   1252   		const hasActiveStream = await this.chatStreamService.hasActiveStream(sessionId);
   1253   		const currentMessageId = await this.chatStreamService.getCurrentMessageId(sessionId);
   1254   		const pendingChunks = await this.chatStreamService.getPendingChunks(
   1255   			sessionId,
   1256   			lastReceivedSequence,
   1257   		);
   1258   
   1259   		return {
   1260   			hasActiveStream,
   1261   			currentMessageId,
   1262   			pendingChunks,
   1263   			lastSequenceNumber:
   1264   				pendingChunks.length > 0
   1265   					? pendingChunks[pendingChunks.length - 1].sequenceNumber
   1266   					: lastReceivedSequence,
   1267   		};
   1268   	}
   1269   
   1270   	private async executeChatWorkflowWithCleanup(
   1271   		user: User,
   1272   		model: ChatHubConversationModel,
   1273   		workflow: PreparedChatWorkflow,
   1274   		sessionId: ChatSessionId,
   1275   		previousMessageId: ChatMessageId,
   1276   		retryOfMessageId: ChatMessageId | null,
   1277   		originalPreviousMessageId: ChatMessageId | null,
   1278   		credentials: INodeCredentials,
   1279   		humanMessage: string,
   1280   		processedAttachments: IBinaryData[],
   1281   		pushRef?: string,
   1282   	) {
   1283   		await this.chatHubExecutionService.executeChatWorkflowWithCleanup(
   1284   			user,
   1285   			model,
   1286   			workflow.workflowData,
   1287   			workflow.executionData,
   1288   			sessionId,
   1289   			previousMessageId,
   1290   			retryOfMessageId,
   1291   			workflow.responseMode,
   1292   			pushRef,
   1293   		);
   1294   
   1295   		// Generate title for the session on receiving the first human message.
   1296   		// Skip for manual (canvas) executions - they are ephemeral test runs.
   1297   		if (originalPreviousMessageId === null && humanMessage && !pushRef) {
   1298   			try {
   1299   				await this.chatHubTitleService.generateSessionTitle(
   1300   					user,
   1301   					sessionId,
   1302   					humanMessage,
   1303   					processedAttachments,
   1304   					credentials,

	/**
	 * Deletes the user's sessions whose last message is older than the given number of days.
	 * The database cascade removes the messages. Returns the number of deleted sessions.
	 */
	async deleteStaleSessions(userId: string, olderThanDays: number): Promise<number> {
		const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - olderThanDays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);

		return await this.messageRepository.manager.transaction(async (trx) => {
			const ids = await this.sessionRepository.getIdsByUserIdLastMessageBefore(userId, cutoff, trx);
			for (const id of ids) {
				await this.chatHubAttachmentService.deleteAllBySessionId(id, trx);
			}
			return await this.sessionRepository.deleteManyByIds(ids, userId, trx);
		});
	}

    314   	/**
    315   	 * Build the message history chain ending to the message with ID `lastMessageId`

    317   	private buildMessageHistory(
    318   		messages: Record<ChatMessageId, ChatHubMessage>,
    319   		lastMessageId: ChatMessageId | null,
    320   	) {
    321   		if (!lastMessageId) return [];
    322   
    323   		const visited = new Set<string>();
    324   		const historyIds = [];
    325   
    326   		let current: ChatMessageId | null = lastMessageId;
    327   
    328   		while (current && !visited.has(current)) {
    329   			historyIds.unshift(current);
    330   			visited.add(current);
    331   			current = messages[current]?.previousMessageId ?? null;
    332   		}
    333   
    334   		const history = historyIds.flatMap((id) => messages[id] ?? []);
    335   		return history;
    336   	}

    558   				return { workflow: replyWorkflow, previousMessage };

    776   	/**
    777   	 * Edit a message and stream the AI response via Push events.

    779   	 */
    780   	async editMessage(
    781   		user: User,

    783   		executionMetadata: ChatHubAuthenticationMetadata,
    784   	): Promise<void> {
    785   		const { sessionId, editId, messageId, message, model, credentials, timeZone } = payload;
    786   		const tz = timeZone ?? this.globalConfig.generic.timezone;
    787   
    788   		let result: {
    789   			workflow: PreparedChatWorkflow | null;
    790   			combinedAttachments: IBinaryData[];
    791   		} | null = null;
    792   		let newStoredAttachments: IBinaryData[] = [];
    793   
    794   		try {
    795   			result = await this.messageRepository.runInTransaction({}, async (trx, ctx) => {
    796   				const session = await this.getChatSession(user, sessionId, trx);
    797   				if (!session) {
    798   					throw new NotFoundError('Chat session not found');
    799   				}
    800   
    801   				const messageToEdit = await this.getChatMessage(session.id, editId, [], trx);
    802   
    803   				if (messageToEdit.type === 'ai') {
    804   					throw new BadRequestError('Editing AI messages is not supported');
    805   				}
    806   
    807   				if (messageToEdit.type === 'human') {
    808   					const messages = Object.fromEntries((session.messages ?? []).map((m) => [m.id, m]));
    809   					const history = this.buildMessageHistory(messages, messageToEdit.previousMessageId);
    810   
    811   					const revisionOfMessageId = messageToEdit.revisionOfMessageId ?? messageToEdit.id;
    812   					const originalAttachments = messageToEdit.attachments ?? [];
    813   
    814   					const keptAttachments = payload.keepAttachmentIndices.flatMap((index) => {
    815   						const attachment = originalAttachments[index];
    816   						return attachment ? [attachment] : [];
    817   					});
    818   
    819   					newStoredAttachments =
    820   						payload.newAttachments.length > 0
    821   							? await this.chatHubAttachmentService.store(
    822   									sessionId,
    823   									messageId,
    824   									payload.newAttachments,
    825   								)
    826   							: [];
    827   
    828   					const attachments = [...keptAttachments, ...newStoredAttachments];
    829   
    830   					await this.messageRepository.createHumanMessage(
    831   						payload,
    832   						attachments,
    833   						user,
    834   						messageToEdit.previousMessageId,
    835   						model,
    836   						revisionOfMessageId,
    837   						trx,
    838   					);
    839   
    840   					const tools = await this.chatHubToolService.getToolDefinitionsForSession(sessionId, trx);
    841   
    842   					const workflow = await this.chatHubWorkflowService.prepareReplyWorkflow(
    843   						user,
    844   						sessionId,
    845   						credentials,
    846   						model,
    847   						history,
    848   						message,
    849   						tools,
    850   						attachments,
    851   						tz,
    852   						ctx,
    853   						executionMetadata,
    854   					);
    855   
    856   					return { workflow, combinedAttachments: attachments };
    857   				}
    858   
    859   				throw new BadRequestError('Only human and AI messages can be edited');
    860   			});
    861   		} catch (error) {
    862   			if (newStoredAttachments.length > 0) {
    863   				try {
    864   					await this.chatHubAttachmentService.deleteAttachments(newStoredAttachments);
    865   				} catch {
    866   					this.errorReporter.warn(`Could not clean up ${newStoredAttachments.length} files`);
    867   				}
    868   			}
    869   
    870   			throw error;
    871   		}
    872   
    873   		if (!result?.workflow) {
    874   			// AI message edit - no streaming needed
    875   			return;
    876   		}
    877   
    878   		const { workflow } = result;
    879   
    880   		// Broadcast message edit to all user connections for cross-client sync
    881   		await this.chatStreamService.sendMessageEdit({
    882   			userId: user.id,
    883   			sessionId,
    884   			revisionOfMessageId: editId,
    885   			messageId,
    886   			content: message,
    887   			attachments: result.combinedAttachments.map((a) => ({
    888   				id: a.id!,
    889   				fileName: a.fileName ?? 'file',
    890   				mimeType: a.mimeType,
    891   			})),
    892   		});
    893   
    894   		// Start the workflow execution with streaming
    895   		void this.executeChatWorkflowWithCleanup(
    896   			user,
    897   			model,
    898   			workflow,
    899   			sessionId,
    900   			messageId,
    901   			null,
    902   			null,
    903   			{},
    904   			'',
    905   			[],
    906   		);
    907   	}

   1064   	/**
   1065   	 * Regenerate an AI message and stream via Push events.
   1066   	 * Returns immediately; streaming happens in background.
   1067   	 */
   1068   	async regenerateAIMessage(
   1069   		user: User,
   1070   		payload: RegenerateMessagePayload,
   1071   		executionMetadata: ChatHubAuthenticationMetadata,
   1072   	): Promise<void> {
   1073   		const { sessionId, retryId, model, credentials, timeZone } = payload;
   1074   		const tz = timeZone ?? this.globalConfig.generic.timezone;
   1075   
   1076   		const { retryOfMessageId, previousMessageId, workflow } =
   1077   			await this.messageRepository.runInTransaction({}, async (trx, ctx) => {
   1078   				const session = await this.getChatSession(user, sessionId, trx);
   1079   				if (!session) {
   1080   					throw new NotFoundError('Chat session not found');
   1081   				}
   1082   
   1083   				const messageToRetry = await this.getChatMessage(session.id, retryId, [], trx);
   1084   
   1085   				if (messageToRetry.type !== 'ai') {
   1086   					throw new BadRequestError('Can only retry AI messages');
   1087   				}
   1088   
   1089   				const messages = Object.fromEntries((session.messages ?? []).map((m) => [m.id, m]));
   1090   				const history = this.buildMessageHistory(messages, messageToRetry.previousMessageId);
   1091   
   1092   				const lastHumanMessage = history.filter((m) => m.type === 'human').pop();
   1093   				if (!lastHumanMessage) {
   1094   					throw new BadRequestError('No human message found to base the retry on');
   1095   				}
   1096   
   1097   				const lastHumanMessageIndex = history.indexOf(lastHumanMessage);
   1098   				if (lastHumanMessageIndex !== -1) {
   1099   					history.splice(lastHumanMessageIndex);
   1100   				}
   1101   
   1102   				const retryOfMessageId = messageToRetry.retryOfMessageId ?? messageToRetry.id;
   1103   				const message = lastHumanMessage ? lastHumanMessage.content : '';
   1104   				const attachments = lastHumanMessage.attachments ?? [];
   1105   
   1106   				const tools = await this.chatHubToolService.getToolDefinitionsForSession(sessionId, trx);
   1107   
   1108   				const workflow = await this.chatHubWorkflowService.prepareReplyWorkflow(
   1109   					user,
   1110   					sessionId,
   1111   					credentials,
   1112   					model,
   1113   					history,
   1114   					message,

	/**
	 * Deletes the user's sessions whose last message is older than the given number of days.
	 * Messages are removed by the database cascade. Returns the number of deleted sessions.
	 */
	async deleteSessionsOlderThan(userId: string, olderThanDays: number): Promise<number> {
		const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - olderThanDays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);

		return await this.messageRepository.manager.transaction(async (trx) => {
			const sessionIds = await this.sessionRepository.getIdsByOwnerLastMessageBefore(
				userId,
				cutoff,
				trx,
			);

			for (const sessionId of sessionIds) {
				await this.chatHubAttachmentService.deleteAllBySessionId(sessionId, trx);
			}
			await this.sessionRepository.deleteByIds(sessionIds, trx);

			return sessionIds.length;
		});
	}

    314   	/**

    317   	private buildMessageHistory(
    318   		messages: Record<ChatMessageId, ChatHubMessage>,
    319   		lastMessageId: ChatMessageId | null,
    320   	) {
    321   		if (!lastMessageId) return [];
    322   
    323   		const visited = new Set<string>();
    324   		const historyIds = [];
    325   
    326   		let current: ChatMessageId | null = lastMessageId;
    327   
    328   		while (current && !visited.has(current)) {
    329   			historyIds.unshift(current);
    330   			visited.add(current);
    331   			current = messages[current]?.previousMessageId ?? null;
    332   		}
    333   
    334   		const history = historyIds.flatMap((id) => messages[id] ?? []);
    335   		return history;
    336   	}

    425   	private async ensureValidModel(
    426   		user: User,
    427   		model: ChatHubConversationModel,
    428   		manual: boolean,
    429   		trx?: EntityManager,
    430   	) {
    431   		if (model.provider === 'custom-agent') {
    432   			// Find the agent to get its name
    433   			const agent = await this.chatHubAgentService.getAgentById(model.agentId, user.id, trx);
    434   			if (!agent) {
    435   				throw new BadRequestError('Agent not found for chat session initialization');
    436   			}
    437   		}
    438   
    439   		if (model.provider === 'n8n') {
    440   			// Find the workflow to get its name
    441   			const workflowEntity = await this.workflowFinderService.findWorkflowForUser(
    442   				model.workflowId,
    443   				user,
    444   				['workflow:execute-chat'],
    445   				{
    446   					includeTags: false,
    447   					includeParentFolder: false,
    448   					includeActiveVersion: manual ? false : true,
    449   					em: trx,
    450   				},
    451   			);
    452   
    453   			if (!workflowEntity) {
    454   				throw new BadRequestError('Workflow not found for chat session initialization');
    455   			}
    456   
    457   			// In manual mode, validate against draft nodes; otherwise use activeVersion
    458   			const nodes = manual ? workflowEntity.nodes : workflowEntity.activeVersion?.nodes;
    459   
    460   			if (!nodes) {
    461   				throw new BadRequestError('Workflow not found for chat session initialization');
    462   			}
    463   
    464   			const chatTrigger = nodes.find((node) => node.type === CHAT_TRIGGER_NODE_TYPE);
    465   
    466   			if (!chatTrigger) {
    467   				throw new BadRequestError(
    468   					'Chat trigger not found in workflow for chat session initialization',
    469   				);
    470   			}
    471   		}
    472   	}

    474   	/**
    475   	 * Send a human message and stream the AI response via Push events.
    476   	 * Returns immediately, streaming happens in background after.
    477   	 */
    478   	async sendHumanMessage(
    479   		user: User,
    480   		payload: HumanMessagePayload,
    481   		executionMetadata: ChatHubAuthenticationMetadata,
    482   	): Promise<void> {
    483   		const {
    484   			sessionId,
    485   			messageId,
    486   			message,
    487   			model,
    488   			credentials,
    489   			previousMessageId,
    490   			attachments,
    491   			timeZone,
    492   		} = payload;
    493   		const tz = timeZone ?? this.globalConfig.generic.timezone;
    494   
    495   		const credentialId = this.getModelCredential(model, credentials);
    496   
    497   		let processedAttachments: IBinaryData[] = [];
    498   		let workflow: PreparedChatWorkflow;
    499   		let previousMessage: ChatHubMessage | undefined;
    500   
    501   		try {
    502   			const result = await this.messageRepository.runInTransaction({}, async (trx, ctx) => {
    503   				let session = await this.getChatSession(user, sessionId, trx);
    504   				const isNewSession = !session;
    505   				session ??= await this.createChatSession(
    506   					user,
    507   					sessionId,
    508   					model,
    509   					credentialId,
    510   					false,
    511   					payload.agentName,
    512   					trx,
    513   				);
    514   
    515   				const previousMessage = await this.ensurePreviousMessage(previousMessageId, sessionId, trx);
    516   				const messages = Object.fromEntries((session.messages ?? []).map((m) => [m.id, m]));
    517   				const history = this.buildMessageHistory(messages, previousMessageId);
    518   
    519   				// Validate attachments against the model's upload policy before storing
    520   				if (attachments.length > 0) {
    521   					const policy = await this.chatHubWorkflowService.getAttachmentPolicy(model, user, trx);
    522   					this.chatHubAttachmentService.validateAttachments(
    523   						attachments,
    524   						policy.allowFileUploads,
    525   						policy.allowedFilesMimeTypes,
    526   					);
    527   				}
    528   
    529   				// Store attachments to populate 'id' field via BinaryDataService
    530   				processedAttachments = await this.chatHubAttachmentService.store(
    531   					sessionId,
    532   					messageId,
    533   					attachments,
    534   				);
    535   
    536   				await this.messageRepository.createHumanMessage(
    537   					payload,
    538   					processedAttachments,
    539   					user,
    540   					previousMessageId,
    541   					model,
    542   					undefined,
    543   					trx,
    544   				);
    545   
    546   				// Resolve tool definitions from the session's join table
    547   				const tools = isNewSession
    548   					? (await this.chatHubToolService.getEnabledTools(user.id, trx)).map((t) => t.definition)
    549   					: await this.chatHubToolService.getToolDefinitionsForSession(sessionId, trx);
    550   
    551   				const replyWorkflow = await this.chatHubWorkflowService.prepareReplyWorkflow(
    552   					user,
    553   					sessionId,
    554   					credentials,
    555   					model,
    556   					history,
    557   					message,
    558   					tools,
    559   					processedAttachments,
    560   					tz,
    561   					ctx,
    562   					executionMetadata,
    563   				);
    564   
    565   				return { workflow: replyWorkflow, previousMessage };
    566   			});
    567   			workflow = result.workflow;
    568   			previousMessage = result.previousMessage;
    569   		} catch (error) {
    570   			if (processedAttachments.length > 0) {
    571   				try {
    572   					await this.chatHubAttachmentService.deleteAttachments(processedAttachments);
    573   				} catch {
    574   					this.errorReporter.warn(`Could not clean up ${processedAttachments.length} files`);
    575   				}
    576   			}
    577   
    578   			throw error;
    579   		}
    580   
    581   		if (!workflow) {
    582   			throw new UnexpectedError('Failed to prepare chat workflow.');
    583   		}
    584   
    585   		// Broadcast human message to all user connections for cross-client sync
    586   		await this.chatStreamService.sendHumanMessage({
    587   			userId: user.id,
    588   			sessionId,
    589   			messageId,
    590   			previousMessageId,
    591   			content: message,
    592   			attachments: processedAttachments.map((a) => ({
    593   				id: a.id!,
    594   				fileName: a.fileName ?? 'file',
    595   				mimeType: a.mimeType,
    596   			})),
    597   		});
    598   
    599   		const resumed = await this.tryResumeWaitingExecution({
    600   			workflow,
    601   			previousMessage,
    602   			message,
    603   			sessionId,
    604   			user,
    605   			messageId,
    606   			model,
    607   		});
    608   		if (resumed) return;
    609   
    610   		// Start the workflow execution with streaming
    611   		void this.executeChatWorkflowWithCleanup(
    612   			user,
    613   			model,
    614   			workflow,
    615   			sessionId,
    616   			messageId,
    617   			null,
    618   			previousMessageId,
    619   			credentials,
    620   			message,
    621   			processedAttachments,
    622   		);
    623   	}

    246   		return session;

    262   	/**
    263   	 * Get all conversations for a user
    264   	 */
    265   	async getConversations(
    266   		userId: string,
    267   		limit: number,
    268   		cursor?: string,
    269   		type?: string,
    270   	): Promise<ChatHubConversationsResponse> {
    271   		const sessions = await this.sessionRepository.getManyByUserId(userId, limit + 1, cursor, type);
    272   
    273   		const hasMore = sessions.length > limit;
    274   		const data = hasMore ? sessions.slice(0, limit) : sessions;
    275   		const nextCursor = hasMore ? data[data.length - 1].id : null;
    276   
    277   		return {
    278   			data: data.map((session) => this.convertSessionEntityToDto(session)),
    279   			nextCursor,
    280   			hasMore,
    281   		};
    282   	}

    314   	/**
    315   	 * Build the message history chain ending to the message with ID `lastMessageId`
    316   	 */
    317   	private buildMessageHistory(
    318   		messages: Record<ChatMessageId, ChatHubMessage>,
    319   		lastMessageId: ChatMessageId | null,
    320   	) {
    321   		if (!lastMessageId) return [];
    322   
    323   		const visited = new Set<string>();
    324   		const historyIds = [];
    325   
    326   		let current: ChatMessageId | null = lastMessageId;
    327   
    328   		while (current && !visited.has(current)) {
    329   			historyIds.unshift(current);
    330   			visited.add(current);
    331   			current = messages[current]?.previousMessageId ?? null;
    332   		}
    333   
    334   		const history = historyIds.flatMap((id) => messages[id] ?? []);
    335   		return history;
    336   	}

    344   	/**
    345   	 * Updates a session with the provided fields
    346   	 */
    347   	async updateSession(
    348   		user: User,
    349   		sessionId: ChatSessionId,
    350   		updates: ChatHubUpdateConversationRequest,
    351   	) {
    352   		await this.ensureConversation(user.id, sessionId);
    353   
    354   		// Prepare the actual updates to be sent to the repository
    355   		const sessionUpdates: Partial<IChatHubSession> = {};
    356   
    357   		if (updates.agent) {
    358   			const model = updates.agent.model;
    359   
    360   			await this.ensureValidModel(user, model, false);
    361   
    362   			sessionUpdates.agentName = updates.agent.name;
    363   			sessionUpdates.provider = model.provider;
    364   			sessionUpdates.model = null;
    365   			sessionUpdates.credentialId = null;
    366   			sessionUpdates.agentId = null;
    367   			sessionUpdates.workflowId = null;
    368   
    369   			if (updates.agent.model.provider === 'n8n') {
    370   				sessionUpdates.workflowId = updates.agent.model.workflowId;
    371   			} else if (updates.agent.model.provider === 'custom-agent') {
    372   				sessionUpdates.agentId = updates.agent.model.agentId;
    373   			} else {
    374   				sessionUpdates.model = updates.agent.model.model;
    375   			}
    376   		}
    377   
    378   		if (updates.title !== undefined) sessionUpdates.title = updates.title;
    379   		if (updates.credentialId !== undefined) sessionUpdates.credentialId = updates.credentialId;
    380   
    381   		// One transaction: a rejected tool or a failed field update leaves the session unchanged
    382   		const { toolIds } = updates;
    383   		await this.sessionRepository.runInTransaction({}, async (trx) => {
    384   			if (toolIds !== undefined) {
    385   				await this.chatHubToolService.setSessionTools(sessionId, user.id, toolIds, trx);
    386   			}
    387   			await this.sessionRepository.updateChatSession(sessionId, sessionUpdates, trx);
    388   		});
    389   	}

    397   			await this.chatHubAttachmentService.deleteAllBySessionId(sessionId, trx);
    398   			await this.sessionRepository.deleteChatHubSession(sessionId, trx);
    399   		});

    424   	private async ensureValidModel(
    425   		user: User,
    426   		model: ChatHubConversationModel,
    427   		manual: boolean,
    428   		trx?: EntityManager,
    429   	) {
    430   		if (model.provider === 'custom-agent') {
    431   			// Find the agent to get its name
    432   			const agent = await this.chatHubAgentService.getAgentById(model.agentId, user.id, trx);
    433   			if (!agent) {
    434   				throw new BadRequestError('Agent not found for chat session initialization');
    435   			}
    436   		}
    437   
    438   		if (model.provider === 'n8n') {
    439   			// Find the workflow to get its name
    440   			const workflowEntity = await this.workflowFinderService.findWorkflowForUser(
    441   				model.workflowId,
    442   				user,
    443   				['workflow:execute-chat'],
    444   				{
    445   					includeTags: false,
    446   					includeParentFolder: false,
    447   					includeActiveVersion: manual ? false : true,
    448   					em: trx,
    449   				},
    450   			);
    451   
    452   			if (!workflowEntity) {
    453   				throw new BadRequestError('Workflow not found for chat session initialization');
    454   			}
    455   
    456   			// In manual mode, validate against draft nodes; otherwise use activeVersion
    457   			const nodes = manual ? workflowEntity.nodes : workflowEntity.activeVersion?.nodes;
    458   
    459   			if (!nodes) {
    460   				throw new BadRequestError('Workflow not found for chat session initialization');
    461   			}
    462   
    463   			const chatTrigger = nodes.find((node) => node.type === CHAT_TRIGGER_NODE_TYPE);
    464   
    465   			if (!chatTrigger) {
    466   				throw new BadRequestError(
    467   					'Chat trigger not found in workflow for chat session initialization',
    468   				);
    469   			}
    470   		}
    471   	}

    473   	/**
    474   	 * Send a human message and stream the AI response via Push events.
    475   	 * Returns immediately, streaming happens in background after.
    476   	 */
    477   	async sendHumanMessage(
    478   		user: User,
    479   		payload: HumanMessagePayload,
    480   		executionMetadata: ChatHubAuthenticationMetadata,
    481   	): Promise<void> {
    482   		const {
    483   			sessionId,
    484   			messageId,
    485   			message,
    486   			model,
    487   			credentials,
    488   			previousMessageId,
    489   			attachments,
    490   			timeZone,
    491   		} = payload;
    492   		const tz = timeZone ?? this.globalConfig.generic.timezone;
    493   
    494   		const credentialId = this.getModelCredential(model, credentials);
    495   
    496   		let processedAttachments: IBinaryData[] = [];
    497   		let workflow: PreparedChatWorkflow;
    498   		let previousMessage: ChatHubMessage | undefined;
    499   
    500   		try {
    501   			const result = await this.messageRepository.runInTransaction({}, async (trx, ctx) => {
    502   				let session = await this.getChatSession(user, sessionId, trx);
    503   				const isNewSession = !session;
    504   				session ??= await this.createChatSession(
    505   					user,
    506   					sessionId,
    507   					model,
    508   					credentialId,
    509   					false,
    510   					payload.agentName,
    511   					trx,
    512   				);
    513   
    514   				const previousMessage = await this.ensurePreviousMessage(previousMessageId, sessionId, trx);
    515   				const messages = Object.fromEntries((session.messages ?? []).map((m) => [m.id, m]));
    516   				const history = this.buildMessageHistory(messages, previousMessageId);
    517   
    518   				// Validate attachments against the model's upload policy before storing
    519   				if (attachments.length > 0) {
    520   					const policy = await this.chatHubWorkflowService.getAttachmentPolicy(model, user, trx);
    521   					this.chatHubAttachmentService.validateAttachments(
    522   						attachments,
    523   						policy.allowFileUploads,
    524   						policy.allowedFilesMimeTypes,
    525   					);
    526   				}
    527   
    528   				// Store attachments to populate 'id' field via BinaryDataService
    529   				processedAttachments = await this.chatHubAttachmentService.store(
    530   					sessionId,
    531   					messageId,
    532   					attachments,
    533   				);
    534   
    535   				await this.messageRepository.createHumanMessage(
    536   					payload,
    537   					processedAttachments,
    538   					user,
    539   					previousMessageId,
    540   					model,
    541   					undefined,
    542   					trx,
    543   				);
    544   
    545   				// Resolve tool definitions from the session's join table
    546   				const tools = isNewSession
    547   					? (await this.chatHubToolService.getEnabledTools(user.id, trx)).map((t) => t.definition)
    548   					: await this.chatHubToolService.getToolDefinitionsForSession(sessionId, trx);
    549   
    550   				const replyWorkflow = await this.chatHubWorkflowService.prepareReplyWorkflow(
    551   					user,
    552   					sessionId,
    553   					credentials,
    554   					model,
    555   					history,
    556   					message,
    557   					tools,
    558   					processedAttachments,
    559   					tz,
    560   					ctx,
    561   					executionMetadata,
    562   				);
    563   
    564   				return { workflow: replyWorkflow, previousMessage };
    565   			});
    566   			workflow = result.workflow;
    567   			previousMessage = result.previousMessage;
    568   		} catch (error) {
    569   			if (processedAttachments.length > 0) {
    570   				try {
    571   					await this.chatHubAttachmentService.deleteAttachments(processedAttachments);
    572   				} catch {
    573   					this.errorReporter.warn(`Could not clean up ${processedAttachments.length} files`);
    574   				}
    575   			}
    576   
    577   			throw error;
    578   		}
    579   
    580   		if (!workflow) {
    581   			throw new UnexpectedError('Failed to prepare chat workflow.');
    582   		}
    583   
    584   		// Broadcast human message to all user connections for cross-client sync
    585   		await this.chatStreamService.sendHumanMessage({
    586   			userId: user.id,
    587   			sessionId,
    588   			messageId,
    589   			previousMessageId,
    590   			content: message,
    591   			attachments: processedAttachments.map((a) => ({
    592   				id: a.id!,
    593   				fileName: a.fileName ?? 'file',
    594   				mimeType: a.mimeType,
    595   			})),
    596   		});
    597   
    598   		const resumed = await this.tryResumeWaitingExecution({
    599   			workflow,
    600   			previousMessage,
    601   			message,
    602   			sessionId,
    603   			user,
    604   			messageId,
    605   			model,
    606   		});
    607   		if (resumed) return;
    608   
    609   		// Start the workflow execution with streaming
    610   		void this.executeChatWorkflowWithCleanup(
    611   			user,
    612   			model,
    613   			workflow,
    614   			sessionId,
    615   			messageId,
    616   			null,
    617   			previousMessageId,
    618   			credentials,
    619   			message,
    620   			processedAttachments,
    621   		);
    622   	}

    679   					);
    680   					this.chatHubAttachmentService.validateAttachments(

    684   					);
    685   				}
    686   
    687   				processedAttachments = await this.chatHubAttachmentService.store(

    721   				return { workflow: replyWorkflow, previousMessage };
    722   			});
    723   			workflow = result.workflow;

    782   	/**
    783   	 * Edit a message and stream the AI response via Push events.
    784   	 * Returns immediately, streaming happens in background after.
    785   	 */
    786   	async editMessage(
    787   		user: User,
    788   		payload: EditMessagePayload,
    789   		executionMetadata: ChatHubAuthenticationMetadata,
    790   	): Promise<void> {
    791   		const { sessionId, editId, messageId, message, model, credentials, timeZone } = payload;
    792   		const tz = timeZone ?? this.globalConfig.generic.timezone;
    793   
    794   		let result: {
    795   			workflow: PreparedChatWorkflow | null;
    796   			combinedAttachments: IBinaryData[];
    797   		} | null = null;
    798   		let newStoredAttachments: IBinaryData[] = [];
    799   
    800   		try {
    801   			result = await this.messageRepository.runInTransaction({}, async (trx, ctx) => {
    802   				const session = await this.getChatSession(user, sessionId, trx);
    803   				if (!session) {
    804   					throw new NotFoundError('Chat session not found');
    805   				}
    806   
    807   				const messageToEdit = await this.getChatMessage(session.id, editId, [], trx);
    808   
    809   				if (messageToEdit.type === 'ai') {
    810   					throw new BadRequestError('Editing AI messages is not supported');
    811   				}
    812   
    813   				if (messageToEdit.type === 'human') {
    814   					const messages = Object.fromEntries((session.messages ?? []).map((m) => [m.id, m]));
    815   					const history = this.buildMessageHistory(messages, messageToEdit.previousMessageId);
    816   
    817   					const revisionOfMessageId = messageToEdit.revisionOfMessageId ?? messageToEdit.id;
    818   					const originalAttachments = messageToEdit.attachments ?? [];
    819   
    820   					const keptAttachments = payload.keepAttachmentIndices.flatMap((index) => {
    821   						const attachment = originalAttachments[index];
    822   						return attachment ? [attachment] : [];
    823   					});
    824   
    825   					newStoredAttachments =
    826   						payload.newAttachments.length > 0
    827   							? await this.chatHubAttachmentService.store(
    828   									sessionId,
    829   									messageId,
    830   									payload.newAttachments,
    831   								)
    832   							: [];
    833   
    834   					const attachments = [...keptAttachments, ...newStoredAttachments];
    835   
    836   					await this.messageRepository.createHumanMessage(
    837   						payload,
    838   						attachments,
    839   						user,
    840   						messageToEdit.previousMessageId,
    841   						model,
    842   						revisionOfMessageId,
    843   						trx,
    844   					);
    845   
    846   					const tools = await this.chatHubToolService.getToolDefinitionsForSession(sessionId, trx);
    847   
    848   					const workflow = await this.chatHubWorkflowService.prepareReplyWorkflow(
    849   						user,
    850   						sessionId,
    851   						credentials,
    852   						model,
    853   						history,
    854   						message,
    855   						tools,
    856   						attachments,
    857   						tz,
    858   						ctx,
    859   						executionMetadata,
    860   					);
    861   
    862   					return { workflow, combinedAttachments: attachments };

    147   		// websocket uses. A workflow parked on, e.g., a Send-and-Wait approval gate
    148   		// must not be advanced by the next chat message; refuse before any state
    149   		// changes so the gate stays waiting for its real responder.
    150   		if (!this.executionManager.canResumeOverChat(execution)) {
    151   			this.logger.warn(
    152   				`Refused chat-hub resume for execution ${execution.id}: suspended node is not resumable over chat`,
    153   			);
    154   			throw new BadRequestError(
    155   				'This conversation is waiting for a response that cannot be provided from chat.',
    156   			);
    157   		}
    158   
    159   		this.logger.debug(
    160   			`Resuming execution ${execution.id} from waiting state for session ${sessionId}`,
    161   		);
    162   
    163   		await this.messageRepository.updateChatMessage(previousMessage.id, {
    164   			status: 'success',
    165   		});
    166   
    167   		void this.chatHubExecutionService.resumeChatExecution(
    168   			execution,
    169   			message,
    170   			sessionId,
    171   			user,
    172   			messageId,
    173   			model,
    174   			workflow.responseMode,
    175   		);
    176   		return true;
    177   	}

    179   	async stopGeneration(user: User, sessionId: ChatSessionId, messageId: ChatMessageId) {
    180   		await this.ensureConversation(user.id, sessionId);
    181   
    182   		const message = await this.getChatMessage(sessionId, messageId, [
    183   			'execution',
    184   			'execution.workflow',
    185   		]);
    186   
    187   		if (message.type !== 'ai') {
    188   			throw new BadRequestError('Can only stop AI messages');
    189   		}
    190   
    191   		if (!message.executionId || !message.execution) {
    192   			throw new BadRequestError('Message is not associated with a workflow execution');
    193   		}
    194   
    195   		if (message.status !== 'running') {
    196   			throw new BadRequestError('Can only stop messages that are currently running');
    197   		}
    198   
    199   		await this.chatHubExecutionService.stop(message.execution.id, message.execution.workflowId);
    200   		await this.messageRepository.updateChatMessage(messageId, { status: 'cancelled' });
    201   	}

    206   
    207   		return credentialId;

    214   	private async createChatSession(
    215   		user: User,
    216   		sessionId: ChatSessionId,
    217   		model: ChatHubConversationModel,
    218   		credentialId: string | null,
    219   		manual: boolean,
    220   		agentName?: string,
    221   		trx?: EntityManager,
    222   	) {
    223   		await this.ensureValidModel(user, model, manual, trx);
    224   
    225   		const session = await this.sessionRepository.createChatSession(
    226   			{
    227   				id: sessionId,
    228   				ownerId: user.id,
    229   				title: 'New Chat',
    230   				lastMessageAt: new Date(),
    231   				agentName,
    232   				credentialId,
    233   				type: manual ? 'manual' : 'production',
    234   				...model,
    235   			},
    236   			trx,
    237   		);
    238   
    239   		// Populate session tools from enabled configured tools
    240   		const enabledTools = await this.chatHubToolService.getEnabledTools(user.id, trx);
    241   		const toolIds = enabledTools.map((t) => t.id);
    242   		if (toolIds.length > 0) {
    243   			await this.chatHubToolService.setSessionTools(sessionId, user.id, toolIds, trx);
    244   		}
    245   
    246   		return session;
    247   	}

    251   		messageId: ChatMessageId,
    252   		relations: string[] = [],

    254   	) {

    256   		if (!message) {

    262   	/**
    263   	 * Get all conversations for a user
    264   	 */
    265   	async getConversations(
    266   		userId: string,
    267   		limit: number,
    268   		cursor?: string,
    269   		type?: string,
    270   	): Promise<ChatHubConversationsResponse> {
    271   		const sessions = await this.sessionRepository.getManyByUserId(userId, limit + 1, cursor, type);
    272   
    273   		const hasMore = sessions.length > limit;
    274   		const data = hasMore ? sessions.slice(0, limit) : sessions;
    275   		const nextCursor = hasMore ? data[data.length - 1].id : null;
    276   
    277   		return {
    278   			data: data.map((session) => this.convertSessionEntityToDto(session)),
    279   			nextCursor,
    280   			hasMore,
    281   		};
    282   	}

    285   	 * Ensures conversation exists and belongs to the user, throws otherwise
    286   	 * */
    287   	async ensureConversation(userId: string, sessionId: string, trx?: EntityManager): Promise<void> {
    288   		const sessionExists = await this.sessionRepository.existsById(sessionId, userId, trx);
    289   		if (!sessionExists) {

    294   	/**
    295   	 * Get a single conversation with messages and ready to render timeline of latest messages
    296   	 * */
    297   	async getConversation(userId: string, sessionId: string): Promise<ChatHubConversationResponse> {
    298   		const session = await this.sessionRepository.getOneById(sessionId, userId);
    299   		if (!session) {
    300   			throw new NotFoundError('Chat session not found');
    301   		}
    302   
    303   		const messages = session.messages ?? [];
    304   		const toolIds = await this.chatHubToolService.getToolIdsForSession(sessionId);
    305   
    306   		return {
    307   			session: this.convertSessionEntityToDto(session, toolIds),
    308   			conversation: {
    309   				messages: Object.fromEntries(messages.map((m) => [m.id, this.convertMessageToDto(m)])),
    310   			},
    311   		};
    312   	}

    314   	/**
    315   	 * Build the message history chain ending to the message with ID `lastMessageId`
    316   	 */
    317   	private buildMessageHistory(
    318   		messages: Record<ChatMessageId, ChatHubMessage>,
    319   		lastMessageId: ChatMessageId | null,
    320   	) {
    321   		if (!lastMessageId) return [];
    322   
    323   		const visited = new Set<string>();
    324   		const historyIds = [];
    325   
    326   		let current: ChatMessageId | null = lastMessageId;
    327   
    328   		while (current && !visited.has(current)) {
    329   			historyIds.unshift(current);
    330   			visited.add(current);
    331   			current = messages[current]?.previousMessageId ?? null;
    332   		}
    333   
    334   		const history = historyIds.flatMap((id) => messages[id] ?? []);
    335   		return history;
    336   	}

    344   	/**
    345   	 * Updates a session with the provided fields
    346   	 */
    347   	async updateSession(
    348   		user: User,
    349   		sessionId: ChatSessionId,
    350   		updates: ChatHubUpdateConversationRequest,
    351   	) {
    352   		await this.ensureConversation(user.id, sessionId);
    353   
    354   		// Prepare the actual updates to be sent to the repository
    355   		const sessionUpdates: Partial<IChatHubSession> = {};
    356   
    357   		if (updates.agent) {
    358   			const model = updates.agent.model;
    359   
    360   			await this.ensureValidModel(user, model, false);
    361   
    362   			sessionUpdates.agentName = updates.agent.name;
    363   			sessionUpdates.provider = model.provider;
    364   			sessionUpdates.model = null;
    365   			sessionUpdates.credentialId = null;
    366   			sessionUpdates.agentId = null;
    367   			sessionUpdates.workflowId = null;
    368   
    369   			if (updates.agent.model.provider === 'n8n') {
    370   				sessionUpdates.workflowId = updates.agent.model.workflowId;
    371   			} else if (updates.agent.model.provider === 'custom-agent') {
    372   				sessionUpdates.agentId = updates.agent.model.agentId;
    373   			} else {
    374   				sessionUpdates.model = updates.agent.model.model;
    375   			}
    376   		}
    377   
    378   		if (updates.title !== undefined) sessionUpdates.title = updates.title;
    379   		if (updates.credentialId !== undefined) sessionUpdates.credentialId = updates.credentialId;
    380   
    381   		// One transaction: a rejected tool or a failed field update leaves the session unchanged
    382   		const { toolIds } = updates;
    383   		await this.sessionRepository.runInTransaction({}, async (trx) => {
    384   			if (toolIds !== undefined) {
    385   				await this.chatHubToolService.setSessionTools(sessionId, user.id, toolIds, trx);
    386   			}
    387   			await this.sessionRepository.updateChatSession(sessionId, sessionUpdates, trx);
    388   		});
    389   	}

    391   	/**
    392   	 * Deletes a session
    393   	 */
    394   	async deleteSession(userId: string, sessionId: ChatSessionId) {
    395   		await this.messageRepository.manager.transaction(async (trx) => {
    396   			await this.ensureConversation(userId, sessionId, trx);
    397   			await this.chatHubAttachmentService.deleteAllBySessionId(sessionId, trx);
    398   			await this.sessionRepository.deleteChatHubSession(sessionId, trx);
    399   		});
    400   	}

    424   	private async ensureValidModel(
    425   		user: User,
    426   		model: ChatHubConversationModel,
    427   		manual: boolean,
    428   		trx?: EntityManager,
    429   	) {
    430   		if (model.provider === 'custom-agent') {
    431   			// Find the agent to get its name
    432   			const agent = await this.chatHubAgentService.getAgentById(model.agentId, user.id, trx);
    433   			if (!agent) {
    434   				throw new BadRequestError('Agent not found for chat session initialization');
    435   			}
    436   		}
    437   
    438   		if (model.provider === 'n8n') {
    439   			// Find the workflow to get its name
    440   			const workflowEntity = await this.workflowFinderService.findWorkflowForUser(
    441   				model.workflowId,
    442   				user,
    443   				['workflow:execute-chat'],
    444   				{
    445   					includeTags: false,
    446   					includeParentFolder: false,
    447   					includeActiveVersion: manual ? false : true,
    448   					em: trx,
    449   				},
    450   			);
    451   
    452   			if (!workflowEntity) {
    453   				throw new BadRequestError('Workflow not found for chat session initialization');
    454   			}
    455   
    456   			// In manual mode, validate against draft nodes; otherwise use activeVersion
    457   			const nodes = manual ? workflowEntity.nodes : workflowEntity.activeVersion?.nodes;
    458   
    459   			if (!nodes) {
    460   				throw new BadRequestError('Workflow not found for chat session initialization');
    461   			}
    462   
    463   			const chatTrigger = nodes.find((node) => node.type === CHAT_TRIGGER_NODE_TYPE);
    464   
    465   			if (!chatTrigger) {
    466   				throw new BadRequestError(
    467   					'Chat trigger not found in workflow for chat session initialization',
    468   				);
    469   			}
    470   		}
    471   	}

    473   	/**
    474   	 * Send a human message and stream the AI response via Push events.
    475   	 * Returns immediately, streaming happens in background after.
    476   	 */
    477   	async sendHumanMessage(
    478   		user: User,
    479   		payload: HumanMessagePayload,
    480   		executionMetadata: ChatHubAuthenticationMetadata,
    481   	): Promise<void> {
    482   		const {
    483   			sessionId,
    484   			messageId,
    485   			message,
    486   			model,
    487   			credentials,
    488   			previousMessageId,
    489   			attachments,
    490   			timeZone,
    491   		} = payload;
    492   		const tz = timeZone ?? this.globalConfig.generic.timezone;
    493   
    494   		const credentialId = this.getModelCredential(model, credentials);
    495   
    496   		let processedAttachments: IBinaryData[] = [];
    497   		let workflow: PreparedChatWorkflow;
    498   		let previousMessage: ChatHubMessage | undefined;
    499   
    500   		try {
    501   			const result = await this.messageRepository.runInTransaction({}, async (trx, ctx) => {
    502   				let session = await this.getChatSession(user, sessionId, trx);
    503   				const isNewSession = !session;
    504   				session ??= await this.createChatSession(
    505   					user,
    506   					sessionId,
    507   					model,
    508   					credentialId,
    509   					false,
    510   					payload.agentName,
    511   					trx,
    512   				);
    513   
    514   				const previousMessage = await this.ensurePreviousMessage(previousMessageId, sessionId, trx);
    515   				const messages = Object.fromEntries((session.messages ?? []).map((m) => [m.id, m]));
    516   				const history = this.buildMessageHistory(messages, previousMessageId);
    517   
    518   				// Validate attachments against the model's upload policy before storing
    519   				if (attachments.length > 0) {
    520   					const policy = await this.chatHubWorkflowService.getAttachmentPolicy(model, user, trx);
    521   					this.chatHubAttachmentService.validateAttachments(
    522   						attachments,
    523   						policy.allowFileUploads,
    524   						policy.allowedFilesMimeTypes,
    525   					);
    526   				}
    527   
    528   				// Store attachments to populate 'id' field via BinaryDataService
    529   				processedAttachments = await this.chatHubAttachmentService.store(
    530   					sessionId,
    531   					messageId,
    532   					attachments,
    533   				);
    534   
    535   				await this.messageRepository.createHumanMessage(
    536   					payload,
    537   					processedAttachments,
    538   					user,
    539   					previousMessageId,
    540   					model,
    541   					undefined,
    542   					trx,
    543   				);
    544   
    545   				// Resolve tool definitions from the session's join table
    546   				const tools = isNewSession
    547   					? (await this.chatHubToolService.getEnabledTools(user.id, trx)).map((t) => t.definition)
    548   					: await this.chatHubToolService.getToolDefinitionsForSession(sessionId, trx);
    549   
    550   				const replyWorkflow = await this.chatHubWorkflowService.prepareReplyWorkflow(
    551   					user,
    552   					sessionId,
    553   					credentials,
    554   					model,
    555   					history,
    556   					message,
    557   					tools,
    558   					processedAttachments,
    559   					tz,
    560   					ctx,
    561   					executionMetadata,
    562   				);
    563   
    564   				return { workflow: replyWorkflow, previousMessage };
    565   			});
    566   			workflow = result.workflow;
    567   			previousMessage = result.previousMessage;
    568   		} catch (error) {
    569   			if (processedAttachments.length > 0) {
    570   				try {
    571   					await this.chatHubAttachmentService.deleteAttachments(processedAttachments);
    572   				} catch {
    573   					this.errorReporter.warn(`Could not clean up ${processedAttachments.length} files`);
    574   				}
    575   			}
    576   
    577   			throw error;
    578   		}
    579   
    580   		if (!workflow) {
    581   			throw new UnexpectedError('Failed to prepare chat workflow.');
    582   		}
    583   
    584   		// Broadcast human message to all user connections for cross-client sync
    585   		await this.chatStreamService.sendHumanMessage({
    586   			userId: user.id,
    587   			sessionId,
    588   			messageId,
    589   			previousMessageId,
    590   			content: message,
    591   			attachments: processedAttachments.map((a) => ({
    592   				id: a.id!,
    593   				fileName: a.fileName ?? 'file',
    594   				mimeType: a.mimeType,
    595   			})),
    596   		});
    597   
    598   		const resumed = await this.tryResumeWaitingExecution({
    599   			workflow,
    600   			previousMessage,
    601   			message,
    602   			sessionId,
    603   			user,
    604   			messageId,
    605   			model,
    606   		});
    607   		if (resumed) return;
    608   
    609   		// Start the workflow execution with streaming
    610   		void this.executeChatWorkflowWithCleanup(
    611   			user,
    612   			model,
    613   			workflow,
    614   			sessionId,
    615   			messageId,
    616   			null,
    617   			previousMessageId,
    618   			credentials,
    619   			message,
    620   			processedAttachments,
    621   		);
    622   	}

    628   	async sendHumanMessageManual(

    658   				session ??= await this.createChatSession(

    678   						true,
    679   					);
    680   					this.chatHubAttachmentService.validateAttachments(

    682   						policy.allowFileUploads,
    683   						policy.allowedFilesMimeTypes,
    684   					);
    685   				}
    686   
    687   				processedAttachments = await this.chatHubAttachmentService.store(
    688   					sessionId,
    689   					messageId,

    723   			workflow = result.workflow;

    786   	async editMessage(
