    790   	): Promise<void> {
    791   		const { sessionId, editId, messageId, message, model, credentials, timeZone } = payload;
    792   		const tz = timeZone ?? this.globalConfig.generic.timezone;
    793   
    794   		let result: {
    795   			workflow: PreparedChatWorkflow | null;
    796   			combinedAttachments: IBinaryData[];
    797   		} | null = null;
    798   		let newStoredAttachments: IBinaryData[] = [];
    799   
    800   		try {
    801   			result = await this.messageRepository.runInTransaction({}, async (trx, ctx) => {
    802   				const session = await this.getChatSession(user, sessionId, trx);
    803   				if (!session) {
    804   					throw new NotFoundError('Chat session not found');
    805   				}
    806   
    807   				const messageToEdit = await this.getChatMessage(session.id, editId, [], trx);
    808   
    809   				if (messageToEdit.type === 'ai') {
    810   					throw new BadRequestError('Editing AI messages is not supported');
    811   				}
    812   
    813   				if (messageToEdit.type === 'human') {
    814   					const messages = Object.fromEntries((session.messages ?? []).map((m) => [m.id, m]));
    815   					const history = this.buildMessageHistory(messages, messageToEdit.previousMessageId);
    816   
    817   					const revisionOfMessageId = messageToEdit.revisionOfMessageId ?? messageToEdit.id;
    818   					const originalAttachments = messageToEdit.attachments ?? [];
    819   
    820   					const keptAttachments = payload.keepAttachmentIndices.flatMap((index) => {
    821   						const attachment = originalAttachments[index];
    822   						return attachment ? [attachment] : [];
    823   					});
    824   
    825   					newStoredAttachments =
    826   						payload.newAttachments.length > 0
    827   							? await this.chatHubAttachmentService.store(
    828   									sessionId,
    829   									messageId,
    830   									payload.newAttachments,
    831   								)
    832   							: [];
    833   
    834   					const attachments = [...keptAttachments, ...newStoredAttachments];
    835   
    836   					await this.messageRepository.createHumanMessage(
    837   						payload,
    838   						attachments,
    839   						user,
    840   						messageToEdit.previousMessageId,
    841   						model,
    842   						revisionOfMessageId,
    843   						trx,
    844   					);
    845   
    846   					const tools = await this.chatHubToolService.getToolDefinitionsForSession(sessionId, trx);
    847   
    848   					const workflow = await this.chatHubWorkflowService.prepareReplyWorkflow(
    849   						user,
    850   						sessionId,
    851   						credentials,
    852   						model,
    853   						history,
    854   						message,
    855   						tools,
    856   						attachments,
    857   						tz,
    858   						ctx,
    859   						executionMetadata,
    860   					);
    861   
    862   					return { workflow, combinedAttachments: attachments };
    863   				}
    864   
    865   				throw new BadRequestError('Only human and AI messages can be edited');
    866   			});
    867   		} catch (error) {
    868   			if (newStoredAttachments.length > 0) {
    869   				try {
    870   					await this.chatHubAttachmentService.deleteAttachments(newStoredAttachments);
    871   				} catch {
    872   					this.errorReporter.warn(`Could not clean up ${newStoredAttachments.length} files`);
    873   				}
    874   			}
    875   
    876   			throw error;
    877   		}
    878   
    879   		if (!result?.workflow) {
    880   			// AI message edit - no streaming needed
    881   			return;
    882   		}
    883   
    884   		const { workflow } = result;
    885   
    886   		// Broadcast message edit to all user connections for cross-client sync
    887   		await this.chatStreamService.sendMessageEdit({
    888   			userId: user.id,
    889   			sessionId,
    890   			revisionOfMessageId: editId,
    891   			messageId,
    892   			content: message,
    893   			attachments: result.combinedAttachments.map((a) => ({
    894   				id: a.id!,
    895   				fileName: a.fileName ?? 'file',
    896   				mimeType: a.mimeType,
    897   			})),
    898   		});
    899   
    900   		// Start the workflow execution with streaming
    901   		void this.executeChatWorkflowWithCleanup(
    902   			user,
    903   			model,
    904   			workflow,
    905   			sessionId,
    906   			messageId,
    907   			null,
    908   			null,
    909   			{},
    910   			'',
    911   			[],
    912   		);
    913   	}

   1070   	/**
   1071   	 * Regenerate an AI message and stream via Push events.
   1072   	 * Returns immediately; streaming happens in background.
   1073   	 */
   1074   	async regenerateAIMessage(
   1075   		user: User,
   1076   		payload: RegenerateMessagePayload,
   1077   		executionMetadata: ChatHubAuthenticationMetadata,
   1078   	): Promise<void> {
   1079   		const { sessionId, retryId, model, credentials, timeZone } = payload;
   1080   		const tz = timeZone ?? this.globalConfig.generic.timezone;
   1081   
   1082   		const { retryOfMessageId, previousMessageId, workflow } =
   1083   			await this.messageRepository.runInTransaction({}, async (trx, ctx) => {
   1084   				const session = await this.getChatSession(user, sessionId, trx);
   1085   				if (!session) {
   1086   					throw new NotFoundError('Chat session not found');
   1087   				}
   1088   
   1089   				const messageToRetry = await this.getChatMessage(session.id, retryId, [], trx);
   1090   
   1091   				if (messageToRetry.type !== 'ai') {
   1092   					throw new BadRequestError('Can only retry AI messages');
   1093   				}
   1094   
   1095   				const messages = Object.fromEntries((session.messages ?? []).map((m) => [m.id, m]));
   1096   				const history = this.buildMessageHistory(messages, messageToRetry.previousMessageId);
   1097   
   1098   				const lastHumanMessage = history.filter((m) => m.type === 'human').pop();
   1099   				if (!lastHumanMessage) {
   1100   					throw new BadRequestError('No human message found to base the retry on');
   1101   				}
   1102   
   1103   				const lastHumanMessageIndex = history.indexOf(lastHumanMessage);
   1104   				if (lastHumanMessageIndex !== -1) {
   1105   					history.splice(lastHumanMessageIndex);
   1106   				}
   1107   
   1108   				const retryOfMessageId = messageToRetry.retryOfMessageId ?? messageToRetry.id;
   1109   				const message = lastHumanMessage ? lastHumanMessage.content : '';
   1110   				const attachments = lastHumanMessage.attachments ?? [];
   1111   
   1112   				const tools = await this.chatHubToolService.getToolDefinitionsForSession(sessionId, trx);
   1113   
   1114   				const workflow = await this.chatHubWorkflowService.prepareReplyWorkflow(
   1115   					user,
   1116   					sessionId,
   1117   					credentials,
   1118   					model,
   1119   					history,
   1120   					message,
   1121   					tools,
   1122   					attachments,
   1123   					tz,
   1124   					ctx,
   1125   					executionMetadata,
   1126   				);
   1127   
   1128   				return {
   1129   					previousMessageId: lastHumanMessage.id,
   1130   					retryOfMessageId,
   1131   					workflow,
   1132   				};
   1133   			});
   1134   
   1135   		// Start the workflow execution with streaming (fire and forget)
   1136   		void this.executeChatWorkflowWithCleanup(
   1137   			user,
   1138   			model,
   1139   			workflow,
   1140   			sessionId,
   1141   			previousMessageId,
   1142   			retryOfMessageId,
   1143   			null,
   1144   			{},
   1145   			'',
   1146   			[],
   1147   		);
   1148   	}

   1238   	/**
   1239   	 * Reconnect to an active chat stream
   1240   	 * Returns pending chunks that the client may have missed
   1241   	 */
   1242   	async reconnectToStream(
   1243   		sessionId: ChatSessionId,
   1244   		lastReceivedSequence: number,
   1245   	): Promise<{
   1246   		hasActiveStream: boolean;
   1247   		currentMessageId: ChatMessageId | null;
   1248   		pendingChunks: Array<{ sequenceNumber: number; content: string }>;
   1249   		lastSequenceNumber: number;
   1250   	}> {
   1251   		const hasActiveStream = await this.chatStreamService.hasActiveStream(sessionId);
   1252   		const currentMessageId = await this.chatStreamService.getCurrentMessageId(sessionId);
   1253   		const pendingChunks = await this.chatStreamService.getPendingChunks(
   1254   			sessionId,
   1255   			lastReceivedSequence,
   1256   		);
   1257   
   1258   		return {
   1259   			hasActiveStream,
   1260   			currentMessageId,
   1261   			pendingChunks,
   1262   			lastSequenceNumber:
   1263   				pendingChunks.length > 0
   1264   					? pendingChunks[pendingChunks.length - 1].sequenceNumber
   1265   					: lastReceivedSequence,
   1266   		};
   1267   	}

   1269   	private async executeChatWorkflowWithCleanup(
   1270   		user: User,
   1271   		model: ChatHubConversationModel,
   1272   		workflow: PreparedChatWorkflow,
   1273   		sessionId: ChatSessionId,
   1274   		previousMessageId: ChatMessageId,
   1275   		retryOfMessageId: ChatMessageId | null,
   1276   		originalPreviousMessageId: ChatMessageId | null,
   1277   		credentials: INodeCredentials,
   1278   		humanMessage: string,
   1279   		processedAttachments: IBinaryData[],
   1280   		pushRef?: string,
   1281   	) {
   1282   		await this.chatHubExecutionService.executeChatWorkflowWithCleanup(
   1283   			user,
   1284   			model,
   1285   			workflow.workflowData,
   1286   			workflow.executionData,
   1287   			sessionId,
   1288   			previousMessageId,
   1289   			retryOfMessageId,
   1290   			workflow.responseMode,
   1291   			pushRef,
   1292   		);
   1293   
   1294   		// Generate title for the session on receiving the first human message.
   1295   		// Skip for manual (canvas) executions - they are ephemeral test runs.
   1296   		if (originalPreviousMessageId === null && humanMessage && !pushRef) {
   1297   			try {
   1298   				await this.chatHubTitleService.generateSessionTitle(
   1299   					user,
   1300   					sessionId,
   1301   					humanMessage,
   1302   					processedAttachments,
   1303   					credentials,
   1304   					model,
   1305   				);
   1306   			} catch (error) {
   1307   				this.logger.warn(`Title generation failed: ${error}`);
   1308   			}
   1309   		}
   1310   	}

   1312   	private convertMessageToDto(message: ChatHubMessage): ChatHubMessageDto {
   1313   		return {
   1314   			id: message.id,
   1315   			sessionId: message.sessionId,
   1316   			type: message.type,
   1317   			name: message.name,
   1318   			content: parseMessage(message),
   1319   			provider: message.provider,
   1320   			model: message.model,
   1321   			workflowId: message.workflowId,
   1322   			agentId: message.agentId,
   1323   			executionId: message.executionId,
   1324   			status: message.status,
   1325   			createdAt: message.createdAt.toISOString(),
   1326   			updatedAt: message.updatedAt.toISOString(),
   1327   
   1328   			previousMessageId: message.previousMessageId,
   1329   			retryOfMessageId: message.retryOfMessageId,
   1330   			revisionOfMessageId: message.revisionOfMessageId,
   1331   
   1332   			attachments: (message.attachments ?? []).map(({ fileName, mimeType }) => ({
   1333   				fileName,
   1334   				mimeType,
   1335   			})),
   1336   		};
   1337   	}

   1339   	private convertSessionEntityToDto(
   1340   		session: ChatHubSession,
   1341   		toolIds: string[] = [],
   1342   	): ChatHubSessionDto {
   1343   		const agent = session.workflow
   1344   			? this.chatHubModelsService.extractModelFromWorkflow(session.workflow, [])
   1345   			: session.agent
   1346   				? this.chatHubAgentService.convertAgentEntityToModel(session.agent)
   1347   				: undefined;
   1348   
   1349   		return {
   1350   			id: session.id,
   1351   			title: session.title,
   1352   			ownerId: session.ownerId,
   1353   			lastMessageAt: session.lastMessageAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
   1354   			credentialId: session.credentialId,
   1355   			provider: session.provider,
   1356   			model: session.model,

	/**
	 * Deletes the user's sessions whose last message is older than the given
	 * number of days. Messages are removed with their session.
	 * Returns the number of deleted sessions.
	 */
	async deleteStaleSessions(userId: string, olderThanDays: number): Promise<number> {
		const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - olderThanDays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);

		return await this.messageRepository.manager.transaction(async (trx) => {
			const ids = await this.sessionRepository.getIdsByUserIdLastMessageBefore(userId, cutoff, trx);

			for (const id of ids) {
				await this.chatHubAttachmentService.deleteAllBySessionId(id, trx);
			}

			// Chunk to stay below the database limit on bound parameters.
			let deleted = 0;
			for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i += 500) {
				deleted += await this.sessionRepository.deleteByIdsAndUserId(
					ids.slice(i, i + 500),
					userId,
					trx,
				);
			}
			return deleted;
		});
	}

    317   	private buildMessageHistory(
    318   		messages: Record<ChatMessageId, ChatHubMessage>,
    319   		lastMessageId: ChatMessageId | null,
    320   	) {
    321   		if (!lastMessageId) return [];
    322   
    323   		const visited = new Set<string>();

    325

    331   			current = messages[current]?.previousMessageId ?? null;
    332   		}
    333   
    334   		const history = historyIds.flatMap((id) => messages[id] ?? []);
    335   		return history;
    336   	}

   1075   	/**
   1076   	 * Regenerate an AI message and stream via Push events.
   1077   	 * Returns immediately; streaming happens in background.
   1078   	 */
   1079   	async regenerateAIMessage(
   1080   		user: User,
   1081   		payload: RegenerateMessagePayload,
   1082   		executionMetadata: ChatHubAuthenticationMetadata,
   1083   	): Promise<void> {
   1084   		const { sessionId, retryId, model, credentials, timeZone } = payload;
   1085   		const tz = timeZone ?? this.globalConfig.generic.timezone;
   1086   
   1087   		const { retryOfMessageId, previousMessageId, workflow } =
   1088   			await this.messageRepository.runInTransaction({}, async (trx, ctx) => {
   1089   				const session = await this.getChatSession(user, sessionId, trx);
   1090   				if (!session) {
   1091   					throw new NotFoundError('Chat session not found');
   1092   				}
   1093   
   1094   				const messageToRetry = await this.getChatMessage(session.id, retryId, [], trx);
   1095   
   1096   				if (messageToRetry.type !== 'ai') {
   1097   					throw new BadRequestError('Can only retry AI messages');
   1098   				}
   1099   
   1100   				const messages = Object.fromEntries((session.messages ?? []).map((m) => [m.id, m]));
   1101   				const history = this.buildMessageHistory(messages, messageToRetry.previousMessageId);
   1102   
   1103   				const lastHumanMessage = history.filter((m) => m.type === 'human').pop();
   1104   				if (!lastHumanMessage) {
   1105   					throw new BadRequestError('No human message found to base the retry on');
   1106   				}
   1107   
   1108   				const lastHumanMessageIndex = history.indexOf(lastHumanMessage);
   1109   				if (lastHumanMessageIndex !== -1) {
   1110   					history.splice(lastHumanMessageIndex);
   1111   				}
   1112   
   1113   				const retryOfMessageId = messageToRetry.retryOfMessageId ?? messageToRetry.id;
   1114   				const message = lastHumanMessage ? lastHumanMessage.content : '';
   1115   				const attachments = lastHumanMessage.attachments ?? [];
   1116   
   1117   				const tools = await this.chatHubToolService.getToolDefinitionsForSession(sessionId, trx);
   1118   
   1119   				const workflow = await this.chatHubWorkflowService.prepareReplyWorkflow(
   1120   					user,
   1121   					sessionId,
   1122   					credentials,
   1123   					model,
   1124   					history,
   1125   					message,
   1126   					tools,
   1127   					attachments,
   1128   					tz,
   1129   					ctx,
   1130   					executionMetadata,
   1131   				);
   1132   
   1133   				return {
   1134   					previousMessageId: lastHumanMessage.id,
   1135   					retryOfMessageId,
   1136   					workflow,
   1137   				};
   1138   			});

   1144   			workflow,
   1145   			sessionId,
   1146   			previousMessageId,
   1147   			retryOfMessageId,
   1148   			null,
   1149   			{},
   1150   			'',
   1151   			[],
   1152   		);
   1153   	}

    486   						body.base64Encoded = 'data:' + binaryData.mimeType + ';base64,' + binaryData.data;
    487   						body.metadata = {
    488   							filename: binaryData.fileName,
    489   						};
    490   					} else {
    491   						const fileUrl = this.getNodeParameter('fileUrl', i) as string;
    492   
    493   						body.metadata = {
    494   							redirect_url: fileUrl,
    495   						};
    496   					}
    497   
    498   					responseData = [
    499   						await koBoToolboxApiRequest.call(this, {
    500   							method: 'POST',
    501   							url: `/api/v2/assets/${formId}/files/`,
    502   							body,
    503   						}),
    504   					];
    505   				}
    506   			}
    507   
    508   			returnData = returnData.concat(responseData);
    509   		}
    510   
    511   		// Map data to n8n data
    512   		return binaryItems.length > 0 ? [binaryItems] : [this.helpers.returnJsonArray(returnData)];
    513   	}
    514   }

    592   						{ itemData: { item: i } },

    594   					returnData.push(...executionData);
    595   				} else if (operation === 'updateGroups') {
    596   					// ----------------------------------
    597   					//       member: updateGroups

    599   
    600   					const groupIds = this.getNodeParameter('groupIds', i) as string;
    601   
    602   					const body = {
    603   						groupIds: groupIds.includes(',') ? groupIds.split(',') : [groupIds],
    604   					};
    605   
    606   					const memberId = this.getNodeParameter('memberId', i);
    607   					const endpoint = `/public/members/${memberId}/group-ids`;
    608   					responseData = await bitwardenApiRequest.call(this, 'PUT', endpoint, {}, body);
    609   					const executionData = this.helpers.constructExecutionMetaData(
    610   						this.helpers.returnJsonArray({ success: true }),
    611   						{ itemData: { item: i } },
    612   					);
    613   					returnData.push(...executionData);
    614   				}
    615   			}
    616   		}
    617   
    618   		return [returnData];
    619   	}

    317   	private buildMessageHistory(

    319   		lastMessageId: ChatMessageId | null,

    332   		}
    333

    335   		return history;
    336   	}

   1067   	/**
   1068   	 * Regenerate an AI message and stream via Push events.
   1069   	 * Returns immediately; streaming happens in background.
   1070   	 */
   1071   	async regenerateAIMessage(
   1072   		user: User,
   1073   		payload: RegenerateMessagePayload,
   1074   		executionMetadata: ChatHubAuthenticationMetadata,
   1075   	): Promise<void> {
   1076   		const { sessionId, retryId, model, credentials, timeZone } = payload;
   1077   		const tz = timeZone ?? this.globalConfig.generic.timezone;
   1078   
   1079   		const { retryOfMessageId, previousMessageId, workflow } =
   1080   			await this.messageRepository.runInTransaction({}, async (trx, ctx) => {
   1081   				const session = await this.getChatSession(user, sessionId, trx);
   1082   				if (!session) {
   1083   					throw new NotFoundError('Chat session not found');
   1084   				}
   1085   
   1086   				const messageToRetry = await this.getChatMessage(session.id, retryId, [], trx);
   1087   
   1088   				if (messageToRetry.type !== 'ai') {
   1089   					throw new BadRequestError('Can only retry AI messages');
   1090   				}
   1091   
   1092   				const messages = Object.fromEntries((session.messages ?? []).map((m) => [m.id, m]));
   1093   				const history = this.buildMessageHistory(messages, messageToRetry.previousMessageId);
   1094   
   1095   				const lastHumanMessage = history.filter((m) => m.type === 'human').pop();
   1096   				if (!lastHumanMessage) {
   1097   					throw new BadRequestError('No human message found to base the retry on');
   1098   				}
   1099   
   1100   				const lastHumanMessageIndex = history.indexOf(lastHumanMessage);
   1101   				if (lastHumanMessageIndex !== -1) {
   1102   					history.splice(lastHumanMessageIndex);
   1103   				}
   1104   
   1105   				const retryOfMessageId = messageToRetry.retryOfMessageId ?? messageToRetry.id;
   1106   				const message = lastHumanMessage ? lastHumanMessage.content : '';
   1107   				const attachments = lastHumanMessage.attachments ?? [];
   1108   
   1109   				const tools = await this.chatHubToolService.getToolDefinitionsForSession(sessionId, trx);
   1110   
   1111   				const workflow = await this.chatHubWorkflowService.prepareReplyWorkflow(
   1112   					user,
   1113   					sessionId,
   1114   					credentials,
   1115   					model,
   1116   					history,
   1117   					message,
   1118   					tools,
   1119   					attachments,
   1120   					tz,
   1121   					ctx,
   1122   					executionMetadata,
   1123   				);
   1124   
   1125   				return {
   1126   					previousMessageId: lastHumanMessage.id,
   1127   					retryOfMessageId,
   1128   					workflow,
   1129   				};
   1130   			});

   1132   		// Start the workflow execution with streaming (fire and forget)
   1133   		void this.executeChatWorkflowWithCleanup(
   1134   			user,
   1135   			model,
   1136   			workflow,
   1137   			sessionId,
   1138   			previousMessageId,
   1139   			retryOfMessageId,
   1140   			null,
   1141   			{},
   1142   			'',
   1143   			[],
   1144   		);
   1145   	}

    317   	private buildMessageHistory(

    332   		}

    459   				throw new BadRequestError('Workflow not found for chat session initialization');
    460   			}
    461   
    462   			const chatTrigger = nodes.find((node) => node.type === CHAT_TRIGGER_NODE_TYPE);
    463   
    464   			if (!chatTrigger) {
    465   				throw new BadRequestError(
    466   					'Chat trigger not found in workflow for chat session initialization',
    467   				);
    468   			}

    472   	/**
    473   	 * Send a human message and stream the AI response via Push events.
    474   	 * Returns immediately, streaming happens in background after.
    475   	 */
    476   	async sendHumanMessage(
    477   		user: User,
    478   		payload: HumanMessagePayload,
    479   		executionMetadata: ChatHubAuthenticationMetadata,
    480   	): Promise<void> {
    481   		const {
    482   			sessionId,
    483   			messageId,
    484   			message,
    485   			model,
    486   			credentials,
    487   			previousMessageId,
    488   			attachments,
    489   			timeZone,
    490   		} = payload;
    491   		const tz = timeZone ?? this.globalConfig.generic.timezone;
    492   
    493   		const credentialId = this.getModelCredential(model, credentials);
    494   
    495   		let processedAttachments: IBinaryData[] = [];
    496   		let workflow: PreparedChatWorkflow;
    497   		let previousMessage: ChatHubMessage | undefined;
    498   
    499   		try {
    500   			const result = await this.messageRepository.runInTransaction({}, async (trx, ctx) => {
    501   				let session = await this.getChatSession(user, sessionId, trx);
    502   				const isNewSession = !session;
    503   				session ??= await this.createChatSession(
    504   					user,
    505   					sessionId,
    506   					model,
    507   					credentialId,
    508   					false,
    509   					payload.agentName,
    510   					trx,
    511   				);
    512   
    513   				const previousMessage = await this.ensurePreviousMessage(previousMessageId, sessionId, trx);
    514   				const messages = Object.fromEntries((session.messages ?? []).map((m) => [m.id, m]));
    515   				const history = this.buildMessageHistory(messages, previousMessageId);
    516   
    517   				// Validate attachments against the model's upload policy before storing
    518   				if (attachments.length > 0) {
    519   					const policy = await this.chatHubWorkflowService.getAttachmentPolicy(model, user, trx);
    520   					this.chatHubAttachmentService.validateAttachments(
    521   						attachments,
    522   						policy.allowFileUploads,
    523   						policy.allowedFilesMimeTypes,
    524   					);
    525   				}
    526   
    527   				// Store attachments to populate 'id' field via BinaryDataService
    528   				processedAttachments = await this.chatHubAttachmentService.store(
    529   					sessionId,
    530   					messageId,
    531   					attachments,
    532   				);
    533   
    534   				await this.messageRepository.createHumanMessage(
    535   					payload,
    536   					processedAttachments,
    537   					user,
    538   					previousMessageId,
    539   					model,
    540   					undefined,
    541   					trx,
    542   				);
    543   
    544   				// Resolve tool definitions from the session's join table
    545   				const tools = isNewSession
    546   					? (await this.chatHubToolService.getEnabledTools(user.id, trx)).map((t) => t.definition)
    547   					: await this.chatHubToolService.getToolDefinitionsForSession(sessionId, trx);
    548   
    549   				const replyWorkflow = await this.chatHubWorkflowService.prepareReplyWorkflow(
    550   					user,
    551   					sessionId,
    552   					credentials,
    553   					model,
    554   					history,
    555   					message,
    556   					tools,
    557   					processedAttachments,
    558   					tz,
    559   					ctx,
    560   					executionMetadata,
    561   				);
    562   
    563   				return { workflow: replyWorkflow, previousMessage };
    564   			});
    565   			workflow = result.workflow;
    566   			previousMessage = result.previousMessage;
    567   		} catch (error) {
    568   			if (processedAttachments.length > 0) {
    569   				try {
    570   					await this.chatHubAttachmentService.deleteAttachments(processedAttachments);
    571   				} catch {
    572   					this.errorReporter.warn(`Could not clean up ${processedAttachments.length} files`);
    573   				}
    574   			}
    575   
    576   			throw error;
    577   		}
    578   
    579   		if (!workflow) {
    580   			throw new UnexpectedError('Failed to prepare chat workflow.');
    581   		}
    582   
    583   		// Broadcast human message to all user connections for cross-client sync
    584   		await this.chatStreamService.sendHumanMessage({
    585   			userId: user.id,
    586   			sessionId,
    587   			messageId,
    588   			previousMessageId,
    589   			content: message,
    590   			attachments: processedAttachments.map((a) => ({
    591   				id: a.id!,
    592   				fileName: a.fileName ?? 'file',
    593   				mimeType: a.mimeType,
    594   			})),
    595   		});
    596   
    597   		const resumed = await this.tryResumeWaitingExecution({
    598   			workflow,
    599   			previousMessage,
    600   			message,
    601   			sessionId,
    602   			user,
    603   			messageId,
    604   			model,
    605   		});
    606   		if (resumed) return;
    607   
    608   		// Start the workflow execution with streaming
    609   		void this.executeChatWorkflowWithCleanup(
    610   			user,
    611   			model,
    612   			workflow,
    613   			sessionId,
    614   			messageId,
    615   			null,
    616   			previousMessageId,
    617   			credentials,
    618   			message,
    619   			processedAttachments,
    620   		);
    621   	}

    792   
    793   		let result: {

    796   		} | null = null;
    797   		let newStoredAttachments: IBinaryData[] = [];

    799   		try {
    800   			result = await this.messageRepository.runInTransaction({}, async (trx, ctx) => {
    801   				const session = await this.getChatSession(user, sessionId, trx);
    802   				if (!session) {
    803   					throw new NotFoundError('Chat session not found');
    804   				}
    805   
    806   				const messageToEdit = await this.getChatMessage(session.id, editId, [], trx);
    807   
    808   				if (messageToEdit.type === 'ai') {
    809   					throw new BadRequestError('Editing AI messages is not supported');
    810   				}
    811   
    812   				if (messageToEdit.type === 'human') {

    814   					const history = this.buildMessageHistory(messages, messageToEdit.previousMessageId);
    815   
    816   					const revisionOfMessageId = messageToEdit.revisionOfMessageId ?? messageToEdit.id;
    817   					const originalAttachments = messageToEdit.attachments ?? [];
    818   
    819   					const keptAttachments = payload.keepAttachmentIndices.flatMap((index) => {
    820   						const attachment = originalAttachments[index];
    821   						return attachment ? [attachment] : [];
    822   					});
    823   
    824   					newStoredAttachments =
    825   						payload.newAttachments.length > 0
    826   							? await this.chatHubAttachmentService.store(
    827   									sessionId,
    828   									messageId,
    829   									payload.newAttachments,
    830   								)
    831   							: [];
    832   
    833   					const attachments = [...keptAttachments, ...newStoredAttachments];
    834   
    835   					await this.messageRepository.createHumanMessage(
    836   						payload,
    837   						attachments,
    838   						user,
    839   						messageToEdit.previousMessageId,
    840   						model,
    841   						revisionOfMessageId,
    842   						trx,
    843   					);
    844   
    845   					const tools = await this.chatHubToolService.getToolDefinitionsForSession(sessionId, trx);
    846   
    847   					const workflow = await this.chatHubWorkflowService.prepareReplyWorkflow(
    848   						user,
    849   						sessionId,
    850   						credentials,
    851   						model,
    852   						history,
    853   						message,
    854   						tools,
    855   						attachments,
    856   						tz,
    857   						ctx,
    858   						executionMetadata,
    859   					);
    860   
    861   					return { workflow, combinedAttachments: attachments };
    862   				}
    863   
    864   				throw new BadRequestError('Only human and AI messages can be edited');
    865   			});
    866   		} catch (error) {
    867   			if (newStoredAttachments.length > 0) {
    868   				try {
    869   					await this.chatHubAttachmentService.deleteAttachments(newStoredAttachments);
    870   				} catch {
    871   					this.errorReporter.warn(`Could not clean up ${newStoredAttachments.length} files`);
    872   				}
    873   			}
    874   
    875   			throw error;
    876   		}
    877   
    878   		if (!result?.workflow) {
    879   			// AI message edit - no streaming needed
    880   			return;
    881   		}
    882   
    883   		const { workflow } = result;
    884   
    885   		// Broadcast message edit to all user connections for cross-client sync
    886   		await this.chatStreamService.sendMessageEdit({
    887   			userId: user.id,
    888   			sessionId,
    889   			revisionOfMessageId: editId,
    890   			messageId,
    891   			content: message,
    892   			attachments: result.combinedAttachments.map((a) => ({
    893   				id: a.id!,
    894   				fileName: a.fileName ?? 'file',
    895   				mimeType: a.mimeType,
    896   			})),
    897   		});
    898   
    899   		// Start the workflow execution with streaming
    900   		void this.executeChatWorkflowWithCleanup(
    901   			user,
    902   			model,
    903   			workflow,
    904   			sessionId,
    905   			messageId,
    906   			null,
    907   			null,
    908   			{},
    909   			'',
    910   			[],
    911   		);
    912   	}
